tools.name: AddPortfolioLot
tools.title: Add Portfolio Lot
tools.description: Record a user-confirmed purchase or sale in the caller's portfolio. Never infer or guess the instrument, quantity, price or date. For stock, pass ticker; a listing on another exchange is its MIC:TICKER symbol (e.g. XPAR:AIR, as ScreenStocks returns it). For an option, pass both its underlying ticker (MIC:TICKER for a Canadian contract, e.g. XTSE:RY) and verified OCC symbol from GetOptionChain; unknown or expired contracts are rejected. quantity is signed: positive for long shares/contracts, negative for short stock or written options. costPerUnit is always the positive per-share price or option premium, never the per-contract total, in the currency the listing trades in and in major units (London prices in pounds, not pence). For crypto, pass crypto (the coin's symbol, e.g. BTC) instead of ticker, with the amount and the US dollar price per coin. Identical retries within the duplicate window return the existing lot instead of adding another.

portfolio.description: The portfolio to add to, by name.

quantity.description: Signed size: shares for a stock, contracts for an option, coins for crypto. Negative for a short sale or a written option.

costPerUnit.description: Price per share, always positive: paid for a long, received for a short. For an option, the premium per share (a $3.20 contract is 3.20, not 320). In the currency the stock trades in, in major units: London prices in pounds, not pence. For crypto, the US dollar price per coin.

acquiredDate.description: The trade date, as yyyy-MM-dd. Cannot be in the future.

ticker.description: Stock ticker, or MIC:TICKER for a listing on another exchange, e.g. XPAR:AIR. For an option, the UNDERLYING's ticker, e.g. AAPL, or XTSE:RY for a Canadian contract. Omit it for crypto.

optionContract.description: Optional. The OCC option symbol, e.g. O:AAPL260724C00110000. Provide it to record an option contract; omit it for shares.

crypto.description: Optional. A coin's symbol, e.g. BTC or ETH, to record crypto instead of a stock. It is matched to coins only, never to a stock with the same letters.

note.description: Optional. A short note from the user about this lot, up to 256 characters.

fxRate.description: Optional. The broker's exchange rate on the trade, as units of the portfolio's currency per 1 unit of the stock's trading currency (e.g. 0.92 for EUR per USD). Only when the user states it; omit to convert at the official rate on the trade date.

tools.name: AnalyzeOptionStrategy
tools.title: Analyze Option Strategy
tools.description: Work out the arithmetic of one to four proposed option legs: net debit or credit, payoff, breakevens and whole-position greeks. Long legs price at the ask and short legs at the bid; a leg without a usable quote falls back to its last trade, and the answer then says the result cannot be executed at. Legs in one expiration give a terminal payoff; legs in two give one result per path, since the back legs still carry time value at the front expiration. This is reference arithmetic, not a recommendation, and it states no probability of profit. Plus reads delayed indicative quotes, Pro real-time; the Free plan is answered with an upgrade note. US tickers only.

ticker.description: US stock ticker, e.g. AAPL

legs.description: One to four legs, each an OCC symbol, a side (long or short) and a quantity

contract.description: Exact OCC option symbol returned by the option chain or contract read.

quantity.description: Positive number of contracts for this leg (default 1, max 100).

tools.name: ClosePortfolioLot
tools.title: Close Portfolio Lot
tools.description:
Record that the USER sold (or covered, or let expire) all or part of a lot, at a price and on a date. The lot moves out of the open positions and its realized profit is kept. Ask the user for the closing price and date; never guess them from a market quote.

Closing PART of a lot splits it: the closed part keeps the original cost basis and the rest stays open on that same basis, so a later sale is still priced against what was actually paid.

An option that expired worthless closes at a price of 0. An option that was exercised or assigned closes here too, and the resulting shares are a separate AddPortfolioLot.

portfolio.description: The portfolio holding the lot, by name.

lotId.description: The lot id shown by GetMyPortfolio, e.g. a1b2c3d4.

closePrice.description: Price per share received (or paid, to cover a short). Zero for an option that expired worthless.

closeDate.description: The closing date, as yyyy-MM-dd. Cannot be in the future or before the lot was acquired.

quantity.description: Optional. How much of the lot to close, as a positive size. Omit to close all of it.

tools.name: CompareFinancialFact
tools.title: Compare Financials Across Companies
tools.description: Compare one financial concept across several companies for the same fiscal period — peer comparison. Returns one row per ticker with the latest-restated value; tickers with no data for the period are listed separately. By default fiscal year/period follow each company's OWN fiscal calendar (e.g. NVDA's fiscal 2025 ended January 2025), so peer rows can cover very different calendar months — check the Period End column. For a calendar year ('2025 revenue of NVDA, AMD and INTC'), pass basis 'calendar': each company's fiscal year holding most of its days in that year.

tickers.description: Ticker symbols to compare (max 25); a listing on another exchange is MIC:TICKER (XPAR:AIR).

concept.description: Concept alias, e.g. 'revenue', 'net-income', 'eps-diluted'. Call with an unknown value to list supported aliases.

fiscalYear.description: The year compared, e.g. 2025. With basis 'fiscal': each company's period ending in that calendar year, so a January year end covers mostly the year before (NVDA's fiscal 2025 ended January 2025); a company that names that year for the year it starts in (most January year-end retailers) is labelled with its own name. With basis 'calendar': each company's fiscal year holding most of its days in that year.

basis.description: 'fiscal' (default): periods by each company's fiscal calendar. 'calendar': fiscal years lined up by the calendar year holding most of their days; FY only.

tools.name: CompareInstitutionPortfolios
tools.title: Portfolio Overlap Between Institutions
tools.description: Compare two institutions' 13F portfolios on their latest common report date. Returns Jaccard and dollar-weighted overlap, portfolio totals, and shared or unique positions. Counts common shares only; puts, calls and principal amounts are left out. Published values normally use report-date closing prices, may fall back to filer values, and can be zero when unavailable. Resolve filer names with SearchInstitutions. For mutual-fund or ETF NPORT portfolios, use GetFundProfile.

institutionName1.description: First institution name or CIK (a unique partial resolves; ambiguous partials return candidate CIKs)

institutionName2.description: Second institution name or CIK (a unique partial resolves; ambiguous partials return candidate CIKs)

reportDate.description: Quarter-end 13F report date in YYYY-MM-DD format (defaults to the latest common quarter; an off-quarter date snaps to the nearest common report on or before it)

maxResults.description: Maximum number of stocks to return (default: 30, clamped to 1-500)

tools.name: CreateMyPortfolio
tools.title: Create My Portfolio
tools.description: Create a new, empty portfolio in the USER's own Equibles account, then add holdings to it with AddPortfolioLot. Ask the user before creating one, since it is their account. Names are unique within an account, and re-creating a name that already exists is rejected rather than merged. Totals are reported in the portfolio's currency; each holding stays in the currency its listing trades in.

name.description: A short name for the portfolio, e.g. Main or Retirement.

currency.description: Optional. ISO code the totals are reported in: USD (default), EUR, GBP, CHF, DKK, NOK, SEK, CNY, HKD, CAD, JPY, INR or BRL. Use the user's home currency.

tools.name: DeleteMyPortfolio
tools.title: Delete My Portfolio
tools.description: Permanently delete one of the USER's own portfolios and every lot in it, open and closed. This cannot be undone and it destroys the recorded cost basis and realized-profit history. ALWAYS confirm with the user first, naming the portfolio and how many lots it holds. Call GetMyPortfolio if you do not already know.

name.description: The exact name of the portfolio to delete.

tools.name: FindInReader
tools.title: Find In Reader
tools.description: Used by the Equibles filing reader already on screen to find words in its document. Not for answering a question: SearchDocument searches a filing's text.

split.description: The cut of it the reader holds.

tools.name: GetAllHolders
tools.title: All Holders of a Stock
tools.description: Get every disclosed holder of a stock or ETF listing in one table: 13F institutions, Schedule 13D and 13G filers, insiders (Forms 3, 4, 5) and registered funds (N-PORT). The default view shows one row per holder from its freshest filing, with its other filings and the 13D/G, insider and fund disclosures its 13F report contains nested under it, matched by CIK and SEC reporting links, never by name. Shares are restated onto today's split basis, change is against the same holder's previous filing in the same source, and % Out is of shares outstanding. Funds are never summed: their shares sit inside their advisers' 13F reports. view=all lists every row flat, stale ones included; view=ultimate groups the summed holders under their ultimate parent and lists each parent's members with the link that put them there. Use GetOwnershipSummary for the totals.

ticker.description: Listed security ticker (e.g., NVDA, VOO)

source.description: Source to list: all (default), 13f, 13dg (13D and 13G), 13d, 13g, insider, fund or nonus (non-US disclosures a deployment adds). A single source lists its rows flat, stale ones flagged.

view.description: default (one row per holder, others nested), all (every row flat, stale included) or ultimate (summed holders grouped by ultimate parent, members listed beneath)

holderTypes.description: Holder types to keep, as an array of tokens: adv, era, ia, bank, ins, bd, fund, plan, nonus, hc, unk (insiders and holders without a deciding record read unk), e.g. ["bank"]. Types come from regulatory records, never names. Omit for all.

maxResults.description: Maximum number of rows (holders, or parents for view=ultimate) to return (default: 25, clamped to 1-500)

offset.description: Number of ranked rows to skip before returning results (default: 0)

tools.name: GetAnalystEstimates
tools.title: Analyst Consensus Estimates
tools.description: Read analyst consensus forecasts for a company, including revenue, EPS, product, segment and operating metrics. Prefers consensus the company publishes itself through its investor-relations sources and falls back to a compiled consensus; every answer states which kind answered. Returns original units, accounting basis, mean/median/range/count labels, snapshot history and publication dates. Coverage varies by issuer. This reads stored verified data and never scrapes on demand.

ticker.description: Stock ticker symbol (e.g., SAP), or MIC:TICKER (e.g., XETR:SAP) for a listing outside the US.

metric.description: Exact source metric label; omit to read all metrics.

period.description: Exact source forecast-period label; omit for all periods.

dimensions.description: Exact source dimension label; omit for all products and segments.

snapshotId.description: Snapshot identifier from a previous response; omit for latest verified capture.

asOf.description: ISO-8601 UTC cutoff for a snapshot verified at or before this instant.

snapshotOffset.description: Zero-based snapshot history offset; history is returned in pages of 10.

offset.description: Zero-based observation offset, default 0, maximum 100000.

tools.name: GetAtmPrograms
tools.title: At-the-Market Offering Programs
tools.description: Get a company's at-the-market (ATM) equity offering programs — original agreement date and stated precision, latest amendment, money and/or share capacity, cumulative sales, remaining availability with per-figure as-of dates, expiry, derived exhausted/expired status, and source filings. Bare table figures are normalized only from an exact grounded filing scale header. ATM programs have no tagged XBRL equivalent, so figures come from verified extractions of the company's own 10-K, 10-Q and 8-K filings; only filings from roughly the last 13 months are scanned, so an empty result means no program was captured there — not proof the company runs no ATM program. Nothing is estimated.

ticker.description: Stock ticker symbol (e.g., AAPL, MSFT).

tools.name: GetAverageTrueRange
tools.title: Average True Range (ATR)
tools.description: Average True Range (ATR) for a stock. Wilder's volatility measure built from the True Range (max of high-low, |high-prev_close|, |low-prev_close|) and smoothed recursively. Higher ATR means wider daily moves; commonly used for position sizing and stop placement. ATR is denominated in the stock's price units (USD for a US listing, the listing's own quote unit otherwise). The smoothing is warmed up on price history fetched before startDate, so values do not depend on the requested range's left edge.

ticker.description: Stock ticker symbol (e.g., AAPL, MSFT). Class shares use a dash (BRK-B); the dot form (BRK.B) is also accepted. A listing on another exchange is MIC:TICKER (XPAR:AIR).

startDate.description: Start date in YYYY-MM-DD format (defaults to 6 months ago)

endDate.description: End date in YYYY-MM-DD format (defaults to latest available)

maxResults.description: Maximum number of records to return (default: 60, max: 500); the newest rows are kept and listed newest first.

tools.name: GetBeneficialOwnership
tools.title: Stock 13D and 13G Filers
tools.description: Get the Schedule 13D and 13G beneficial-ownership record of a stock or ETF listing: each filer's latest 13D or 13G, its event date, the block's shares (restated onto today's split basis) and percent of class, the change since the filer's previous 13D or 13G, and every reporting person on the cover pages with their own amount, percent and sole or shared voting and dispositive power. Reporting persons on one filing each claim the same block, so never add them together. Largest block first.

ticker.description: Listed security ticker (e.g., NVDA, BRK-B)

maxResults.description: Maximum number of filers to return (default: 20, clamped to 1-500)

offset.description: Number of filers to skip before returning results (default: 0)

tools.name: GetBollingerBands
tools.title: Bollinger Bands
tools.description: Bollinger Bands for a stock. A middle band (simple moving average of close) with upper and lower bands set a number of standard deviations above and below it. Bands widen when volatility rises and contract when it falls; price touching the upper/lower band is a common overbought/oversold cue. Includes %B ((close-lower)/(upper-lower)) and bandwidth ((upper-lower)/middle) columns. The moving-average window is warmed up on price history fetched before startDate, so values do not depend on the requested range's left edge.

ticker.description: Stock ticker symbol (e.g., AAPL, MSFT). Class shares use a dash (BRK-B); the dot form (BRK.B) is also accepted. A listing on another exchange is MIC:TICKER (XPAR:AIR).

startDate.description: Start date in YYYY-MM-DD format (defaults to 6 months ago)

endDate.description: End date in YYYY-MM-DD format (defaults to latest available)

stdDev.description: Standard deviations for the upper/lower bands (default: 2)

maxResults.description: Maximum number of records to return (default: 60, max: 500); the newest rows are kept and listed newest first.

tools.name: GetBrazilianFilings
tools.title: Brazilian Company Filings
tools.description: List the documents a company listed on B3 delivered to its securities regulator, for one B3 listing written BVMF:TICKER (e.g. BVMF:WEGE3), newest first, from 2003: material facts, market notices, financial statements, earnings releases, analyst presentations, shareholder meeting documents and its other disclosures. Each row gives the delivery date, the kind of document in English (marked resubmitted when it replaces an earlier one), the company's own description, mostly in Portuguese, and a link that opens the PDF on its Equibles page. Narrow with query, whose words must all appear in the description or kind (e.g. 'material fact', 'dividendos'), and a date range. The documents' text is not searchable: ListFilings, SearchDocuments and ReadDocumentLines cover SEC filings and transcripts, which a Brazilian company has only when it also files with the SEC. For reported figures use GetFinancialStatement.

ticker.description: B3 listing symbol BVMF:TICKER, e.g. BVMF:WEGE3. A bare ticker names a US listing and is answered with the company's B3 listings to ask with.

query.description: Optional words (at most 6) that must all appear in the description or the kind of document, in any case, e.g. 'material fact', 'financial statements', 'assembleia'.

startDate.description: Optional earliest delivery date, YYYY-MM-DD.

endDate.description: Optional latest delivery date, YYYY-MM-DD.

maxResults.description: Maximum filings, newest first (default 20, max 100).

offset.description: Rows to skip for paging (default 0).

tools.name: GetBrazilianFundHoldings
tools.title: Brazilian Fund Holdings of a Stock
tools.description: Get the Brazilian investment funds holding one B3 share, written BVMF:TICKER (e.g. BVMF:PETR4), from each fund's monthly portfolio, largest position first: the fund and its manager, the month, shares held (counting shares lent out), their value in reais, the position's percentage of the fund's net assets and the change in shares from the fund's previous month. Funds may keep positions confidential for a few months, so each fund answers with its newest month that kept nothing confidential, dated per row; a fund that stopped reporting, or whose newest such month is over a year old, is left out. For US registered funds use GetFundsHoldingStock; for Canadian funds GetCanadianFundHoldings.

ticker.description: B3 listing symbol BVMF:TICKER, e.g. BVMF:PETR4. A bare ticker names a US listing and is answered with the company's B3 listings to ask with.

maxResults.description: Maximum funds, largest position first (default 20, max 100).

offset.description: Rows to skip for paging (default 0).

tools.name: GetBrazilianFundPortfolio
tools.title: Brazilian Fund Share Portfolio
tools.description: Get one Brazilian investment fund's share portfolio for a month, largest value first: each share's company and B3 symbol (when the share is a verified B3 listing), common, preferred or unit, shares held (counting shares lent out, also shown alone), value in reais, percentage of the fund's net assets and change in shares from the fund's previous month; with the fund's manager, asset class, net assets and the months it reported, from 2018. Only shares are listed, never the fund's bonds, fund units or derivatives. Funds may keep positions confidential for a few months, so by default it answers the fund's newest month that kept nothing confidential; a month that kept some confidential lists only part of the portfolio and says so. Find the fund with SearchBrazilianFunds.

fund.description: The fund's slug from SearchBrazilianFunds or GetBrazilianFundHoldings, its register number, or its exact name.

month.description: Optional month, YYYY-MM (e.g. 2026-04). Default: the fund's newest month that kept no share position confidential.

maxResults.description: Maximum positions, largest value first (default 50, max 100).

offset.description: Rows to skip for paging (default 0).

tools.name: GetBrazilianInsiderTrading
tools.title: Brazilian Insider Trading
tools.description: Insider trading in a company listed on B3, for one B3 listing written BVMF:TICKER (e.g. BVMF:WEGE3), from the monthly reports the company files for its insider bodies from 2018: the controlling shareholders, board of directors, executive officers, fiscal council and other statutory bodies, each with their related persons. Each body files as one, so no person is named. Returns the monthly totals per body in shares and units (bought, sold, the net value in reais and the holding at the month's end; a month with no purchase or sale by a body is left out), then every transaction in any of the company's own securities, newest first: options, debentures and stock loans included, each with its date, body, kind, security, signed quantity, price and value in reais. For a US listing's SEC Form 4 filings use GetInsiderTransactions.

ticker.description: B3 listing symbol BVMF:TICKER, e.g. BVMF:WEGE3. A bare ticker names a US listing and is answered with the company's B3 listings to ask with.

maxMonths.description: Maximum monthly rows, newest month first (default 12, max 100).

monthOffset.description: Monthly rows to skip for paging back through older months (default 0).

maxResults.description: Maximum transactions, newest first (default 20, max 100).

offset.description: Transactions to skip for paging (default 0).

tools.name: GetBrazilianManagement
tools.title: Brazilian Company Board and Executive Pay
tools.description: Get the board of directors, executive officers and fiscal council of a company listed on B3, and what each body is paid, for one B3 listing written BVMF:TICKER (e.g. BVMF:VALE3), as the company's newest reference form states them. Each body lists a person once, with the highest office they hold there (CEO, CFO, chair, independent member and so on), whether a board seat is independent, the date their first term began and whether the controlling shareholder nominated them. Pay is per body and fiscal year in reais, never per person: average member count, salary and benefits, bonus and profit sharing, share-based, post-employment, termination, other and total, with the highest, average and lowest member's pay, for the past fiscal years and the budget for the year the form covers. For a US listing's executive pay use GetExecutiveCompensation.

ticker.description: B3 listing symbol BVMF:TICKER, e.g. BVMF:VALE3. A bare ticker names a US listing and is answered with the company's B3 listings to ask with.

tools.name: GetBrazilianShareholders
tools.title: Brazilian Company Shareholders
tools.description: Get the major shareholders of a company listed on B3, for one B3 listing written BVMF:TICKER (e.g. BVMF:VALE3), as the company's newest reference form states them: holders of 5% or more of a share class, controllers and members of a shareholder agreement, each with common, preferred and total shares and percentages, nationality and marks for controller and agreement, then the company's treasury shares and every other share. A company holder lists the owners behind it, with percentages of that holder's own capital, not of the company's. Also returns issued capital in reais and shares issued, free float, treasury shares and how many individual, company and institutional shareholders the company has. For a US listing's holders use GetAllHolders.

ticker.description: B3 listing symbol BVMF:TICKER, e.g. BVMF:VALE3. A bare ticker names a US listing and is answered with the company's B3 listings to ask with.

tools.name: GetBuybackPrograms
tools.title: Share Repurchase Programs
tools.description: Get a company's share-repurchase (buyback) picture: tracked programs (announcement date, authorized total in money or shares, remaining availability, expiry, source filings), the latest authorization figures, and repurchase history: cash spent, shares repurchased and average price per fiscal year and recent quarters. Figures come from the company's XBRL facts plus verified extractions of its filings' narrative text and its press releases, including a Canadian normal course issuer bid's maximum number of shares; nothing is estimated, and figures a company stopped restating carry a staleness label. For a B3 listing (BVMF:TICKER) it also lists every board-approved program, newest first: approval and end dates, status, the most shares it may buy of each kind and class against that class's free float, whether bought shares are cancelled or kept in treasury, and the company's treasury shares. For at-the-market (ATM) equity offering programs, the dilution mirror image, see GetAtmPrograms.

ticker.description: Stock ticker symbol (e.g., AAPL, MSFT), or MIC:TICKER (e.g., XTSE:WDO, BVMF:VALE3) for a listing outside the US.

tools.name: GetCanadianFilings
tools.title: Canadian Regulatory Filings (SEDAR+)
tools.description: List the documents a company listed in Canada filed on SEDAR+, the Canadian securities regulators' filing system, for the issuer of one Canadian listing written MIC:TICKER (e.g. XTSE:SHOP, XCNQ:...), newest first: annual and interim financial statements, MD&A, annual information forms, information circulars, news releases, material change reports and prospectuses. Each row gives the filing date, the regulator's category, the document name and a link that opens the document (a PDF) on its Equibles page. Narrow with query, whose words must all appear in the document name or category (e.g. 'financial statements', 'MD&A', 'circular'), and with a date range. The documents' text is not searchable: ListFilings, SearchDocuments and ReadDocumentLines cover SEC filings and transcripts, which a Canadian company has only when it also files with the SEC. For reported figures use GetFinancialStatement.

ticker.description: Canadian listing symbol MIC:TICKER, e.g. XTSE:SHOP. A bare ticker names a US listing and is answered with the company's Canadian listings to ask with.

query.description: Optional words (at most 6) that must all appear in the document name or category, in any case, e.g. 'annual financial statements', 'MD&A', 'information circular'.

startDate.description: Optional earliest filing date, YYYY-MM-DD.

endDate.description: Optional latest filing date, YYYY-MM-DD.

maxResults.description: Maximum filings, newest first (default 20, max 100).

offset.description: Rows to skip for paging (default 0).

tools.name: GetCanadianFundHoldings
tools.title: Canadian ETF Holdings of a Stock
tools.description: Get the Canadian exchange-traded funds holding one Canadian listing, written MIC:TICKER (e.g. XTSE:RY), from each fund's own newest published portfolio, largest position first: the fund's ticker and name, the portfolio's date, shares, value and the position's percentage of the fund. Each fund states its own date, some daily and others monthly. Only funds with a machine-readable portfolio are covered, and a fund that holds other funds is left out so the same shares are never counted twice. For US registered funds use GetFundsHoldingStock; for Swedish funds use GetEuropeanFundHoldings.

ticker.description: Canadian listing symbol MIC:TICKER, e.g. XTSE:RY. A bare ticker names a US listing and is answered with the company's Canadian listings.

maxResults.description: Maximum funds, largest position first (default 20; max 100).

offset.description: Rows to skip for paging (default 0).

tools.name: GetCanadianInsiderTransactions
tools.title: Canadian Insider Transactions (SEDI)
tools.description: Get the insider transactions filed on SEDI, Canada's insider disclosure system, for the issuer of one Canadian listing, written MIC:TICKER (e.g. XTSE:ATD, XTSX:..., XCNQ:..., NEOE:...), newest first. Each row gives the transaction date, the insider and their relationship to the issuer, the registered holder for indirect holdings, the SEDI transaction type, the security (options, share units and warrants included, with the underlying where filed), the signed amount (negative for a disposition) in units of that security, the price and its currency, the holding after the transaction and the filing date. An amended transaction appears once, at its newest amendment. Capture began with about the year before it first ran and grows daily, so older history is missing. For US Form 4 filings use GetInsiderTransactions; for European director dealings use GetEuropeanDirectorTransactions.

ticker.description: Canadian listing symbol MIC:TICKER, e.g. XTSE:ATD. A bare ticker names a US listing and is answered with the company's Canadian listings to ask with.

maxResults.description: Maximum transactions, newest first (default 20, max 100).

offset.description: Rows to skip for paging (default 0).

tools.name: GetCanadianShortPositions
tools.title: Canadian Short Positions (CIRO)
tools.description: Get the aggregate short positions in one Canadian listing, written MIC:TICKER (e.g. XTSE:RY, XTSX:..., XCNQ:..., NEOE:...), from CIRO's Consolidated Short Position Report, newest first. CIRO, the Canadian Investment Regulatory Organization, publishes one report as of the 15th and one as of the last day of each month, a few days later. Each row gives the as-of date, the short position in shares, CIRO's net change since its previous report, and the listing's average daily volume over the trading days since the previous as-of date with the days to cover it implies, both from our own daily volume for that listing, and the shares CIRO reports sold short over the period with their percentage of all shares traded, with CIRO's later corrections applied. Capture began with the reports CIRO still served at its first read, about a year back. For US short interest use GetShortInterest; for European short positions use GetEuropeanShortPositions.

ticker.description: Canadian listing symbol MIC:TICKER, e.g. XTSE:RY. A bare ticker names a US listing and is answered with the company's Canadian listings to ask with.

maxResults.description: Maximum reports, newest first (default 24, about a year; max 100).

offset.description: Rows to skip for paging (default 0).

tools.name: GetCftcPositioning
tools.title: CFTC Futures Positioning (COT)
tools.description: Get Commitments of Traders (COT) positioning data for a specific futures contract. Shows commercial and non-commercial positions over time. Values are contract counts from the legacy futures-only COT report (positions as of each Tuesday, published Friday). Use SearchCftcMarkets to find available market codes.

marketCode.description: CFTC market code, common contract name, or standard futures symbol (e.g., 067651, WTI, ES, Gold futures)

startDate.description: Start date in YYYY-MM-DD format (defaults to 1 year ago)

endDate.description: End date in YYYY-MM-DD format (defaults to latest available)

maxResults.description: Maximum number of reports to return (default: 52, max: 500). When the range holds more reports the newest are kept; rows are always listed oldest to newest.

tools.name: GetCompanyKpis
tools.title: Company KPIs
tools.description: Get company-stated operational and non-GAAP KPIs extracted from written 8-K earnings releases and 10-K/10-Q MD&A, with period, filing date, source quote and exactly comparable year-over-year change. Omit metric for each series' latest reading; pass a company metric label for its full history. Values retain the company's stated scale. Earnings-call transcripts are not figure sources. A disclosed GAAP-to-non-GAAP reconciliation includes its stated bridge.

ticker.description: Stock ticker symbol (e.g., AAPL, MSFT).

metric.description: Optional metric name to expand into its full history (e.g., 'subscribers', 'Adjusted EBITDA'). Matches the company's own metric labels case-insensitively; when the name matches several metrics the tool lists those candidates. Omit for the overview of every metric's latest reading.

tools.name: GetCongressionalTrades
tools.title: Congressional Trades by Stock
tools.description: Get congressional securities transactions for a specific ticker (newest first, last year by default). Shows which members of Congress reported a purchase or sale, with transaction and filing dates; amounts are disclosed ranges, not exact values, and Asset identifies the filed instrument (such as stock, option, or bond). Use GetMemberTrades for one member's transactions across all tickers.

ticker.description: Listed security ticker (e.g., AAPL, VOO, MSFT)

transactionType.description: Filter by transaction type: Purchase or Sale; the synonyms Buy/Sell are accepted (defaults to all)

startDate.description: Start date in YYYY-MM-DD format (defaults to 1 year ago)

endDate.description: End date in YYYY-MM-DD format (defaults to today)

maxResults.description: Maximum number of trades to return (default: 50, max: 500, newest first)

offset.description: Number of matching trades to skip before returning rows (default: 0)

tools.name: GetCorrelatedStocks
tools.title: Correlated Stocks
tools.description: Get the stocks whose daily price returns are most (or least) correlated with one stock — Pearson correlation of daily log returns on comparable raw closes (dividends excluded), computed over the trading days both stocks priced, never on raw price levels. Scope picks the candidate universe: Industry (default) ranks the subject's direct industry peers; Sector widens to sibling industries; Market ranges across the ~1,500 largest listed names and surfaces cross-industry relationships the classification misses (suppliers, commodity proxies). direction=Negative flips the ranking to the strongest inverse movers (hedge candidates). Candidates need a $100M market cap and enough overlapping trading days with the subject; each row reports the observation count behind its coefficient. A MIC:TICKER listing ranks against its own exchange's companies in its trading currency, caps in USD at official rates. Use GetStockPrices for the underlying series and the screener for fundamentals-based peer sets.

ticker.description: Exact listed ticker symbol (e.g., GOOG, GOOGL, BRK-A or BRK-B), or MIC:TICKER (e.g., XTKS:9983) for a listing outside the US. Dot class-share notation such as BRK.A is also accepted.

scope.description: Candidate universe: Industry (default), Sector, or Market (~1,500 largest listed names).

days.description: Trailing calendar window in days for the return series (default 180, clamped to 30-730).

direction.description: Positive (default) for the strongest co-movers, Negative for the strongest inverse movers.

maxResults.description: Maximum number of stocks to return (default 10, max 50).

tools.name: GetCryptoIntradayPrices
tools.title: Crypto Intraday Prices
tools.description: Get price candles within the day for ONE crypto COIN (not a stock: BTC here is Bitcoin), newest first: open, high, low, close, volume in the coin's own units and trades, in US dollars, around the clock. interval is any whole minutes from 1min (default) to 240min, or 1hour to 4hour, counted from midnight UTC. Defaults to the last 7 days (30 for hourly); startDate and endDate set another, back to the coin's first trade. A period without trades has no candle. A cut answer names the next endTime. Candles are added some minutes after they end; the answer says how far they reach. Plus reads a candle 15 minutes after it ends, Free gets an upgrade note. Prices and volume are one exchange's. GetCryptoPrices has daily candles, GetCryptoQuote the latest price.

symbol.description: Coin symbol, e.g. BTC; BTC/USD and BTC-USD also work

interval.description: Candle size: whole minutes from 1min to 240min (e.g. 5min, 15min), or 1hour to 4hour (default: 1min)

startDate.description: First UTC day in YYYY-MM-DD format (default: 7 days before the end, 30 for hourly intervals)

endDate.description: Last UTC day in YYYY-MM-DD format (default: today)

endTime.description: Return only candles that start before this RFC 3339 time; replaces endDate

maxResults.description: Maximum candles to return, newest first (default: 60, max: 500)

tools.name: GetCryptoPrices
tools.title: Crypto Daily Prices
tools.description: Get daily price candles for ONE crypto COIN (not a stock: BTC here is Bitcoin), newest first: open, high, low, close, volume in the coin's own units and trades, in US dollars. A day runs midnight to midnight UTC; a day without trades has no candle. History goes back to the coin's first trade on the exchange (BTC: 2013). Prices and volume are one exchange's, not the whole market's. Plus and Pro also get the day in progress; Free gets a day 4 hours after it ends. GetCryptoQuote has the latest price, GetCryptoIntradayPrices candles within the day, ListCryptoAssets the symbols.

symbol.description: Coin symbol, e.g. BTC; BTC/USD and BTC-USD also work

startDate.description: First UTC day in YYYY-MM-DD format (default: the coin's first trade)

endDate.description: Last UTC day in YYYY-MM-DD format (default: today)

maxResults.description: Maximum days to return, newest first (default: 60, max: 500)

tools.name: GetCryptoQuote
tools.title: Crypto Quote
tools.description: Get the latest US dollar price of crypto COINS (not stocks: BTC here is Bitcoin, not a stock ticker), up to 25 a call: last trade price and its UTC time, the 24-hour change, and the 24-hour volume, high and low. Prices and volume are one exchange's, not the whole market's; there is no market cap. A quiet coin shows an old last-trade time; that is its real last trade. Pro reads real time, Plus 15 minutes delayed, Free gets an upgrade note (daily candles are in GetCryptoPrices). ListCryptoAssets lists the symbols.

symbols.description: Coin symbols (max 25), e.g. BTC, ETH, SOL; BTC/USD and BTC-USD also work

tools.name: GetCustomerConcentration
tools.title: Customer Concentration Risk
tools.description: Get a company's customer-concentration risk disclosure — statements like "one customer accounted for 31% of revenue": each disclosed figure's basis (revenue or receivables), customer count, percentage, and period, with the source filing. Untagged disclosures come from verified narrative extraction with a verbatim quote; issuers that tag ConcentrationRiskPercentage in structured XBRL (e.g. NVDA, AAPL) return those customer-specific dimensioned facts directly. A miss is never a statement of no risk. Pass maxFilings > 1 to also see earlier filings' disclosures (the concentration trend).

ticker.description: Stock ticker symbol (e.g., AAPL, MSFT).

maxFilings.description: How many of the newest disclosing filings to return (default 1 — the latest; cap 10).

tools.name: GetDebtInstrument
tools.title: Debt Instrument Detail
tools.description: Get one durable debt instrument by its Equibles identifier. Returns current balances, linked filing observation, verified covenant bullets, exact source quotes, and governing or amending SEC documents. History, covenants, and documents are independently paged. Use GetDebtProfile first to obtain the instrument identifier.

ticker.description: Stock ticker symbol (e.g., AAPL, MSFT), or MIC:TICKER (e.g., XPAR:AIR) for a listing outside the US.

instrumentId.description: Debt instrument identifier returned by GetDebtProfile.

maxCovenants.description: Maximum covenant rows to return (default 10, max 10).

maxDocuments.description: Maximum governing/update documents to return (default 10, max 10).

evidenceOffset.description: Zero-based character offset into the exact evidence for these history and covenant pages.

tools.name: GetDebtProfile
tools.title: Company Debt Profile
tools.description: Get a company's source-linked reported debt balances, total debt history, and identified notes, loans, and revolving credit facilities. The latest annual report establishes the baseline; subsequent interim reports and event disclosures update durable instrument records instead of creating a new instrument from a similar-looking row. Results summarize each instrument and provide its ID; use GetDebtInstrument for paged covenants, filing observations, exact evidence, and governing SEC exhibits. Unmatched observations are disclosed and excluded.

ticker.description: Stock ticker symbol (e.g., AAPL, MSFT), or MIC:TICKER (e.g., XPAR:AIR) for a listing outside the US.

tools.name: GetDividendHistory
tools.title: Dividend History
tools.description: Get the stored cash dividends of an exact stock or ETF listing, newest first. Each row gives the ex-dividend date and cash amount per share: in USD for a US listing, and in the listing's trading currency for a listing on another exchange (MIC:TICKER). Amounts are as the data source states them today: a dividend paid before a later split is normally restated to the post-split share count, so it can differ from the amount declared at the time. Date filters apply to the ex-dividend date. Future ex-dates can appear after a dividend is declared. Each listing reports its own payments: a share class (BRK-A beside BRK-B) or a fund series sharing its trust's filer (SCHD beside FNDA) never inherits another listing's dividends.

ticker.description: Listed stock or ETF ticker (e.g., AAPL, BRK-A, SCHD); a listing on another exchange is MIC:TICKER (XPAR:AIR).

startDate.description: Optional earliest ex-dividend date in YYYY-MM-DD format.

endDate.description: Optional latest ex-dividend date in YYYY-MM-DD format.

maxResults.description: Maximum number of records to return (default: 20, max: 500).

offset.description: Number of newest matching records to skip for pagination (default: 0).

tools.name: GetEarningsBrief
tools.title: Earnings Brief
tools.description: Get the AI 'Earnings Brief' for a company's recent earnings calls — a verifier-approved TL;DR, bullish and bearish points, and verbatim pull-quotes, plus a deterministic narrative shift against the immediately older available approved brief. When available, it also shows company guidance issued at the call, how that range changed from management's prior update, and the reported quarter versus the operative company guidance that preceded it. This is company guidance, not analyst consensus; actual comparisons use filed GAAP XBRL facts, never estimates. The shift is derived from approved bullets and is not separately verifier-approved. Newest quarter first. Only calls with an approved brief appear, so quarters can be missing from the sequence.

ticker.description: Company ticker symbol (e.g., AAPL, MSFT), or MIC:TICKER (e.g., XPAR:AIR) for a listing outside the US.

limit.description: Maximum number of quarterly briefs to return, newest first (default 2, max 8; values outside 1-8 are clamped)

fiscalYear.description: Company fiscal year. Omit both period fields for newest briefs; year alone filters that fiscal year.

fiscalQuarter.description: Company fiscal quarter, 1-4. Quarter alone filters that quarter across fiscal years; both fields select an exact period.

tools.name: GetEarningsCallEvent
tools.title: Earnings Call Event
tools.description: Get the earnings-call event for a company's fiscal quarter: one record grouping the call's audio, transcript, slide deck and 8-K earnings release. Returns the event id, title, call date, status, each artefact's status (available, pending, notPublished, failed, notAttempted, noCallHeld) with its reason and capture times, the transcript and release document ids, and approved guidance rows from the 8-K. Omit the fiscal period for the latest call; read the transcript with GetEarningsCallTranscript.

ticker.description: Company ticker symbol (e.g., AAPL, MSFT), or MIC:TICKER (e.g., XPAR:AIR) for a listing outside the US.

fiscalYear.description: Company fiscal year. Omit both period fields for the latest call; year alone selects the latest call in that fiscal year.

fiscalQuarter.description: Company fiscal quarter, 1-4. Quarter alone selects the latest matching quarter across fiscal years; provide both fields for an exact period.

tools.name: GetEarningsCallQuestions
tools.title: Earnings Call Analyst Questions
tools.description: Get the analyst questions asked in a call's Q&A, one entry per analyst turn at the microphone, follow-ups included: the analyst and firm, the full question text, who answered, the turn range to read the exchange with GetEarningsCallTranscript or GetInvestorEventTranscript, and audio offsets for calls transcribed from audio. Names appear only for trusted identity resolutions. Pass a ticker with an optional fiscal period, or an eventId.

ticker.description: Company ticker symbol (e.g., AAPL, MSFT), or MIC:TICKER (e.g., XPAR:AIR) for a listing outside the US. Required unless eventId is given.

fiscalYear.description: Company fiscal year. Omit both period fields for the latest call; year alone selects the latest call in that fiscal year.

fiscalQuarter.description: Company fiscal quarter, 1-4. Quarter alone selects the latest matching quarter across fiscal years; provide both fields for an exact period.

eventId.description: Investor event id from ListInvestorEvents or GetEarningsCallEvent; reads any event's Q&A, conferences included. When given, ticker and fiscal period are ignored.

tools.name: GetEarningsCallThemeHistory
tools.title: Earnings Call Theme History
tools.description: Track how a company's earnings-call themes move quarter over quarter: a theme by fiscal-quarter table of mention counts and tone across its last scored calls, oldest first, with each theme's status on the latest call (new, recurring, dropped, or unknown where an unscored quarter sits between the calls compared). Themes are paired across calls by name or shared keywords. Verifier-approved reads only; GetEarningsCallToneAndThemes gives one call's scores and keywords.

ticker.description: Company ticker symbol (e.g., AAPL, MSFT), or MIC:TICKER (e.g., XPAR:AIR) for a listing outside the US.

calls.description: Number of most recent scored fiscal quarters to compare (default 8, max 12; values outside 1-12 are clamped)

tools.name: GetEarningsCallToneAndThemes
tools.title: Earnings Call Tone and Themes
tools.description: Get the AI-scored insights for a company's recent earnings calls — the management-tone read (a net tone score and a hedging score) and the call's key themes with their computed mention counts and per-theme tone. Newest call first. Verifier-approved — only scored and approved calls appear, so quarters can be missing from the sequence (a gap note flags non-consecutive quarters). Use it to gauge how confident or guarded management sounded and what they talked about most.

ticker.description: Company ticker symbol (e.g., AAPL, MSFT), or MIC:TICKER (e.g., XPAR:AIR) for a listing outside the US.

limit.description: Maximum number of scored calls to return, newest first (default 2, max 8; values outside 1-8 are clamped)

fiscalYear.description: Company fiscal year. Omit both period fields for newest results; year alone filters that fiscal year.

fiscalQuarter.description: Company fiscal quarter, 1-4. Quarter alone filters that quarter across fiscal years; both fields select an exact period.

tools.name: GetEarningsCallTranscript
tools.title: Earnings Call Transcript
tools.description: Get the speaker-labelled transcript of a company's earnings call for a fiscal quarter — every speaker turn in order, attributed to the real person (executive or sell-side analyst) with their role at the time. Identities appear only when the resolution is trusted (auto-resolved or human-reviewed); unverified voices show as a role label (e.g. Operator) or a neutral speaker number. While a call is being recorded live, and until its speaker-labelled transcript is ready, the tool returns the preliminary live text instead: numbered machine-transcribed lines without speaker labels, growing every ~20 seconds. Pass after=<the last line number you hold> and run=<the run it reported> to receive only the lines spoken since. The answer says when no transcript exists yet.

ticker.description: Company ticker symbol (e.g., AAPL, MSFT), or MIC:TICKER (e.g., XPAR:AIR) for a listing outside the US.

fiscalYear.description: Company fiscal year. Omit both period fields for the latest call; year alone selects the latest call in that fiscal year.

fiscalQuarter.description: Company fiscal quarter, 1-4. Quarter alone selects the latest matching quarter across fiscal years; provide both fields for an exact period.

limit.description: Maximum number of speaker turns to return (default 50, max 200; values outside 1-200 are clamped)

offset.description: Number of leading speaker turns to skip, for paging through calls longer than the 200-turn cap (default 0)

after.description: Live text only: the highest line number already received (default -1, the whole text so far); the answer then carries only the lines after it

run.description: Live text only: the run value from the previous live answer; a different run means the recording restarted and the answer carries the full text again

tools.name: GetEconomicCalendar
tools.title: Economic Release Calendar
tools.description: Get the economic release calendar — scheduled (upcoming) and recent publication dates of US and Canadian macro data releases, each row naming its market, with the FRED series each release updates and an importance tier per release (High = the tier-1 scheduled market movers: CPI, PPI, Employment Situation, GDP, PCE, retail sales; Medium = other genuine scheduled prints; Low = daily rate/market levels like SOFR or VIX). FOMC meetings are NOT included — FRED's release feed has no real FOMC meeting dates; use the Federal Reserve's published meeting calendar for those. Defaults to the next 30 days. When a window holds more rows than maxResults, the lower tiers are left out first (the answer says how many), so the scheduled prints are never cut for daily rows. Use minImportance=high to see only the market movers, and GetEconomicIndicator to fetch a series' data after it prints.

startDate.description: Start date in YYYY-MM-DD format (defaults to today, UTC)

endDate.description: End date in YYYY-MM-DD format (defaults to 30 days after the start date)

minImportance.description: Minimum importance tier to include: low, medium, or high (defaults to low = everything that fits maxResults, lower tiers left out first)

maxResults.description: Maximum number of release dates to return (default: 100, max: 500, chronological; over the cap, lower importance tiers are left out before any date is cut)

country.description: Market country code, US or CA (defaults to every market)

tools.name: GetEconomicIndicator
tools.title: Economic Indicator History
tools.description: Get time series data for a FRED economic indicator. Returns historical observations for indicators like FEDFUNDS (fed funds rate), DFF (the daily effective federal funds rate, EFFR), DFEDTARU and DFEDTARL (the Federal Reserve's FOMC policy rate target range, upper and lower bound), SOFR, IORB (interest rate on reserve balances), CPIAUCSL (CPI inflation), UNRATE (unemployment), GDP, T10Y2Y (yield spread), VIXCLS (VIX), SP500, MORTGAGE30US, M2SL (money supply), and more. Covers the curated set Equibles tracks, not the full FRED catalog, including Canadian series from the Bank of Canada (BOC-V39079 policy rate, CORRA, 2- and 10-year bond yields) and Statistics Canada (STATCAN-V41690973 CPI, CPI-trim and CPI-median, unemployment, employment, real GDP) — use SearchEconomicIndicators to find available series.

seriesId.description: FRED series ID or standard indicator name (e.g., FEDFUNDS, fed funds rate, core CPI, jobless claims)

startDate.description: Start date in YYYY-MM-DD format (defaults to 1 year before the end date)

endDate.description: End date in YYYY-MM-DD format (defaults to latest available)

maxResults.description: Maximum number of observations to return (default: 100, max: 500). When the range holds more, the newest maxResults are kept; rows are always listed in ascending date order.

transform.description: level (default): the values as published. yoy: also each observation's change from a year earlier, in percent, or in percentage points for a series already stated in percent (inflation from CPIAUCSL, say).

tools.name: GetEtfHoldings
tools.title: ETF Holdings
tools.description: Get an ETF's stored portfolio holdings, largest position first: a US fund's latest SEC Form NPORT-P report (coverage full, partial, or unknown when counts are missing or inconsistent), or, for a fund on another exchange named MIC:TICKER, the fund sponsor's published portfolio file as of its stated date, every row as filed with its weight. Use offset to continue through broad portfolios.

ticker.description: Exact exchange-traded ticker (for example SPY).

maxResults.description: Maximum holdings to return (default 20, max 500).

offset.description: Number of ranked holdings to skip (default 0).

tools.name: GetEtfProfile
tools.title: ETF Profile and Performance
tools.description: Get ETF settled performance, SEC assets, allocation and top holdings. For this exact ETF ticker, use GetStockPrices or GetLatestClosingPrices for prices, GetLiveQuote for entitled intraday quotes, GetOptionExpirations/GetOptionChain/GetOptionContract/GetOptionContractHistory for options, GetShortInterest for reported short interest and days to cover, GetShortVolume/GetOffExchangeVolume/GetFailsToDeliver for trading and settlement data, GetTopHolders/GetInstitutionalOwnershipHistory/GetTopInstitutionalBuyersSellers for 13F institutional exposure, GetFundsHoldingStock for funds owning the ETF, GetDividendHistory for its own declared distributions, and GetCongressionalTrades for congressional trades. These are shared stock-and-ETF tools; GetEtfHoldings instead returns investments inside the ETF. ListFilings/SearchDocuments select the SEC registrant and may include sibling funds, not just this ETF series. Issuer-trained short-interest forecasts and squeeze scores are not ETF analytics.

ticker.description: Exact exchange-traded ticker (for example SPY, VOO, or IVV), or MIC:TICKER for a fund listed on another exchange (for example XETR:SXR8).

tools.name: GetEuropeanDirectorTransactions
tools.title: European Director Transactions
tools.description: Get the director and related-person (PDMR) transactions a regulator published for one listing outside the US, written MIC:TICKER (e.g. XSTO:VOLV-B). Coverage today is Sweden's Finansinspektionen register, matched by the issuer's LEI or the security's ISIN, so rows can include the issuer's other instruments. Each row gives the transaction date, the person and role, a related person where reported, the transaction type, the instrument and ISIN, volume, price and currency, and the source status including amendments. Only captured publication days are covered, and the register is not a complete insider-ownership record. For US Form 4 filings use GetInsiderTransactions.

ticker.description: Listing symbol MIC:TICKER, e.g. XSTO:VOLV-B; a provider suffix such as VOLV-B.ST also works. A bare ticker names a US listing and is answered with the company's listings outside the US to ask with.

maxResults.description: Maximum transactions, newest first (default 20, max 100).

offset.description: Rows to skip for paging (default 0).

tools.name: GetEuropeanFundHoldings
tools.title: European Fund Holdings
tools.description: Get the European investment funds reporting a position in one listing outside the US, written MIC:TICKER (e.g. XSTO:VOLV-B), matched by that security's ISIN. Coverage today is Swedish UCITS quarterly portfolios published by Finansinspektionen with about a two-month delay; special funds are excluded. Each row gives the fund, its manager, the reported quantity, the market value in SEK and the position's weight in the fund's assets, which is not a share of the company. Not comprehensive European ownership and not merged with SEC filings. For US registered funds use GetFundsHoldingStock.

ticker.description: Listing symbol MIC:TICKER, e.g. XSTO:VOLV-B; a provider suffix such as VOLV-B.ST also works. A bare ticker names a US listing and is answered with the company's listings outside the US to ask with.

periodEnd.description: Quarter end in YYYY-MM-DD (e.g. 2026-06-30); omit for the newest captured quarter.

maxResults.description: Maximum fund positions, largest value first (default 20, max 100).

offset.description: Rows to skip for paging (default 0).

tools.name: GetEuropeanShortPositions
tools.title: European Short Positions
tools.description: Get the net short positions disclosed to European regulators for one listing outside the US, written MIC:TICKER (e.g. XPAR:UBI, XAMS:ASML), matched by that security's ISIN, or the issuer's LEI for issuer-level sources: individual holder disclosures from registers such as France's AMF, the Netherlands' AFM and the Spanish, German, Belgian, Irish, Polish, Finnish and Danish registers, plus published aggregates such as Norway's and Sweden's. Values are percentage points of issued share capital. Each register is listed separately and never summed; these are dated disclosures, not total short interest, current holdings or short volume, and a register without a row is not a zero position. Registers checked without a match, not captured yet or out of date are named at the end. For US listings use GetShortInterest.

ticker.description: Listing symbol MIC:TICKER, e.g. XPAR:UBI; a provider suffix such as UBI.PA also works. A bare ticker names a US listing and is answered with the company's listings outside the US to ask with.

maxResults.description: Maximum rows per register, newest first (default 20, max 100).

tools.name: GetExecutiveChanges
tools.title: Executive and Board Changes
tools.description: Get a company's executive and director changes — CEO/CFO/officer/board appointments, resignations, terminations, and retirements — as disclosed in its 8-K Item 5.02 filings, newest filing first. Each change carries the person's name, the role text exactly as filed, a separate normalized role classification, the action, the effective date when stated, the verbatim disclosure (for a departure it also carries, after ' […] ', the filing's own sentence that the departure was not related to results or a disagreement, when the filing states one), and the source filing (form + link). Changes are extracted from the filings' narrative text and verified before publication. Coverage is still back-filling: the output names the oldest covered filing date, and an empty answer distinguishes 'covered filings disclose no changes' from 'filings not yet processed'.

ticker.description: Stock ticker symbol (e.g., AAPL, MSFT).

maxResults.description: Maximum changes to return (default 25, cap 100).

action.description: Optional action filter: Appointed, Resigned, Terminated, or Retired.

startDate.description: Optional oldest filed date, YYYY-MM-DD.

endDate.description: Optional newest filed date, YYYY-MM-DD.

offset.description: Number of matching changes to skip before returning rows (default 0).

tools.name: GetExecutiveCompensation
tools.title: Executive Compensation
tools.description: Get a company's named-executive compensation as disclosed in its DEF 14A proxy statements' Summary Compensation Table — salary, bonus, stock and option awards, non-equity incentive, other compensation, and the company-reported total per executive per fiscal year, newest year first. Figures are exactly as the company disclosed them; Total is the filer's own figure, never a recomputation. Coverage is limited to US DEF 14A filers (foreign private issuers file 20-F and are not covered) and is still back-filling: the output states the newest proxy on file next to the newest imported year, so stale coverage is visible.

ticker.description: Stock ticker symbol (e.g., AAPL, MSFT).

maxYears.description: Optional cap on how many of the newest fiscal years to return (default 0 = all imported years).

tools.name: GetFailsToDeliver
tools.title: Fails-to-Deliver Data
tools.description: Get fails-to-deliver (FTD) data for an exact listed stock or exchange-traded fund from the SEC's twice-monthly FTD files. Quantity is the aggregate net fail-to-deliver position OUTSTANDING on each settlement date — a balance, not that day's new fails, so never sum Quantity across dates. Price is the previous trading day's closing price (SEC file convention, not a settlement price) and Value = Quantity × Price. Within the covered window (the output names the earliest fully covered settlement date), dates absent from the table had no reported fails; earlier dates are only partially covered, so their absence is not evidence of no fails. The SEC publishes each half-month batch with roughly a two-week lag, so the newest rows trail today. High or persistent FTD balances may indicate naked short selling or settlement issues.

ticker.description: Exact stock or ETF ticker symbol (e.g., AAPL, GME, SPY)

startDate.description: Start date in YYYY-MM-DD format (defaults to 3 months ago)

endDate.description: End date in YYYY-MM-DD format (defaults to latest available)

maxResults.description: Maximum number of records to return — keeps the most recent N settlement dates in the range, displayed oldest to newest (default: 90, max: 500)

tools.name: GetFdaAdvisoryCommitteeMeetings
tools.title: FDA Advisory Committee Calendar
tools.description: Get scheduled FDA advisory-committee (AdComm) meetings, sourced from the FDA.gov advisory-committee calendar, each with a link to its FDA meeting page. Defaults to meetings in the next 90 days; pass a date range to look further ahead. This is a forward-looking calendar of announced meetings, not a historical archive — coverage starts in late 2025 — and entries are the FDA's own listings, not linked to stock tickers.

startDate.description: Start date in YYYY-MM-DD format (defaults to today)

endDate.description: End date in YYYY-MM-DD format (defaults to 90 days after the start)

maxResults.description: Maximum number of meetings to return (default: 60, soonest first)

tools.name: GetFinancialFact
tools.title: Financial Concept Lookup
tools.description: Get a single financial concept (e.g. revenue, net income, diluted EPS, total assets, operating cash flow) over time for a company, sourced from SEC Company Facts (structured XBRL), or from the issuer's regulatory filings for a listing outside the US. Returns a time series using the latest restated value unless asOriginallyReported is set: one row per fiscal period for flows, one row per as-of date for balances and share counts. Each row carries its actual period start/end; fiscal years/quarters follow the company's own fiscal calendar. Warns when the selected alias ends materially before the company's other structured facts, which can indicate an XBRL tag change. Adds a newer earnings release's figures as preliminary, or names that 8-K. Dimensioned disclosures such as customer concentration are outside this consolidated-series tool. For a full statement use GetFinancialStatement; to compare peers use CompareFinancialFact.

ticker.description: Stock ticker symbol (e.g., AAPL, MSFT); a listing on another exchange is MIC:TICKER (XPAR:AIR).

concept.description: Concept alias, e.g. 'revenue', 'net-income', 'eps-diluted', 'total-assets', 'operating-cash-flow'. Call with an unknown value to list supported aliases.

form.description: Optional SEC form filter, e.g. '10-K' or '10-Q'

maxResults.description: Maximum periods to return, newest first (default 40, max 200)

asOriginallyReported.description: When true, show the earliest canonical periodic filing instead of the latest restatement within that source priority. Default false.

fiscalPeriod.description: Optional fiscal-period filter: 'FY' (annual only) or 'Q1'..'Q4'. A fourth quarter the filer never reported on its own is the year less its first three quarters, marked (derived), for income and cash-flow lines; other lines have Q4 rows only where the filer reported one.

tools.name: GetFinancialStatement
tools.title: Financial Statements
tools.description: Get a company's income statement, balance sheet, or cash-flow statement for a given fiscal year and period, sourced from SEC Company Facts (structured XBRL), or from the issuer's regulatory filings for a listing outside the US. Returns the standard line items (e.g. revenue, net income, total assets, operating cash flow) with the latest-restated value for one exact statement period end. Quarterly flow rows are always discrete quarters: when the filer reports only cumulative year-to-date values in a currency, the quarter is derived by exact subtraction from the preceding cumulative period and marked Derived. Adds a newer earnings release's figures as preliminary, or names that 8-K. Company-specific dimensional facts (e.g. product-segment revenue) are not included — use GetRevenueBreakdown for segment/geographic revenue, and GetFinancialFact or CompareFinancialFact for one line item across periods or across companies.

ticker.description: Stock ticker symbol (e.g., AAPL, MSFT, GME); a listing on another exchange is MIC:TICKER (XPAR:AIR).

statement.description: Statement: 'income' (income statement), 'balance' (balance sheet), or 'cashflow' (cash-flow statement); the aliases 'is'/'p&l', 'bs' and 'cf' also work. Defaults to income.

year.description: Fiscal year as the company names it, e.g. 2023. Defaults to the year of the latest period with line items to show.

period.description: Fiscal period: 'FY' (annual) or 'Q1'..'Q4'. Defaults to the latest period with line items to show. Most filers report no discrete Q4 income/cash-flow facts in XBRL (the fourth quarter is embedded in the full-year figure) — use 'FY' for annual figures.

tools.name: GetForexIntradayPrices
tools.title: Forex Intraday Prices
tools.description: Get price candles within the day for ONE forex currency pair (EUR/USD), newest first: open, high, low, close in the second currency, volume in the first and trades, around the clock. interval is any whole minutes from 1min (default) to 240min, or 1hour to 4hour, counted from midnight UTC. Defaults to the last 7 days (30 for hourly); startDate and endDate set another, back to the pair's first trade. A period without trades has no candle. A cut answer names the next endTime. Candles are added some minutes after they end; the answer says how far they reach. Plus reads a candle 15 minutes after it ends, Free gets an upgrade note. Rates are one exchange's trades. GetForexPrices has daily candles, GetForexQuote the latest rate.

pair.description: Currency pair, e.g. EUR/USD; EURUSD and EUR-USD also work

interval.description: Candle size: whole minutes from 1min to 240min (e.g. 5min, 15min), or 1hour to 4hour (default: 1min)

startDate.description: First UTC day in YYYY-MM-DD format (default: 7 days before the end, 30 for hourly intervals)

endDate.description: Last UTC day in YYYY-MM-DD format (default: today)

endTime.description: Return only candles that start before this RFC 3339 time; replaces endDate

maxResults.description: Maximum candles to return, newest first (default: 60, max: 500)

tools.name: GetForexPrices
tools.title: Forex Daily Prices
tools.description: Get daily price candles for ONE forex currency pair (EUR/USD), newest first: open, high, low, close in the second currency, volume in the first and trades. A day runs midnight to midnight UTC, weekends included; a day without trades has no candle. History goes back to the pair's first trade on the exchange (EUR/USD: 2020). Rates are one exchange's trades, not an interbank or official reference rate, and a day's high or low can hold a stray trade. Plus and Pro also get the day in progress; Free gets a day 4 hours after it ends. GetForexQuote has the latest rate, GetForexIntradayPrices candles within the day, ListForexPairs the pairs.

pair.description: Currency pair, e.g. EUR/USD; EURUSD and EUR-USD also work

startDate.description: First UTC day in YYYY-MM-DD format (default: the pair's first trade)

endDate.description: Last UTC day in YYYY-MM-DD format (default: today)

maxResults.description: Maximum days to return, newest first (default: 60, max: 500)

tools.name: GetForexQuote
tools.title: Forex Quote
tools.description: Get the latest rate of forex currency pairs (EUR/USD, USD/JPY), up to 25 a call: last trade price and its UTC time, the 24-hour change, and the 24-hour volume (in the first currency), high and low. Rates are one exchange's trades, not an interbank or official reference rate; for official daily rates use GetEconomicIndicator. A thinly traded pair shows an old last-trade time; that is its real last trade. A pair asked the other way round (USD/EUR) answers with the listed pair. Pro reads real time, Plus 15 minutes delayed, Free gets an upgrade note (daily candles are in GetForexPrices). ListForexPairs lists the pairs.

pairs.description: Currency pairs (max 25), e.g. EUR/USD, GBPUSD, USD-JPY

tools.name: GetForm144ProposedSales
tools.title: Proposed Insider Sales (Form 144)
tools.description: Get recent proposed insider sales for a stock from SEC Form 144 notices. Each Form 144 is an affiliate's declaration of intent to sell restricted or control securities, showing the seller, their relationship to the company, the number of shares and aggregate market value to be sold, the proposed sale as a share of the issuer's current shares outstanding, the approximate sale date, the broker, and the filer's remarks (including any stated 10b5-1 plan). Results are the most recent notices first and a note flags when more exist than were returned; use fromDate/toDate to scope a period (heavy 10b5-1 filers can flood the recency window with small daily notices). A proposal may never execute; a completed sale may later appear on Form 4 or 5 only when it is reportable there.

ticker.description: Company ticker symbol (e.g., AAPL, MSFT)

maxResults.description: Maximum number of notices to return (default: 50, max: 500; values outside 1-500 are clamped)

fromDate.description: Optional earliest filing date to include, ISO format yyyy-MM-dd (e.g., 2025-01-01)

toDate.description: Optional latest filing date to include, ISO format yyyy-MM-dd (e.g., 2025-12-31)

offset.description: Number of matching notices to skip before returning rows (default: 0)

tools.name: GetFormDOfferings
tools.title: Exempt Offerings (Form D)
tools.description: Get recent exempt securities offerings (private placements) for a company from SEC Form D notices. Each Form D reports a Regulation D offering, showing the issuer, the date of first sale, the total offering amount (a dollar figure or "Indefinite"), the amounts sold and remaining, the minimum investment, the number of investors, the claimed exemptions, whether the notice is an amendment (D/A), and its SEC accession number. Ongoing offerings are re-noticed through D/A amendments that RESTATE the same offering — group rows by first-sale date and offering amount and use only the latest notice of each chain, or capital raised will be counted several times over. Use this to track how a company is raising private capital alongside its public filings.

ticker.description: Company ticker symbol (e.g., AAPL, MSFT)

maxResults.description: Maximum number of notices to return (default: 50, max: 500; values outside 1-500 are clamped)

fromDate.description: Optional earliest filing date to include, ISO format yyyy-MM-dd (e.g., 2024-01-01)

toDate.description: Optional latest filing date to include, ISO format yyyy-MM-dd (e.g., 2024-12-31)

offset.description: Number of matching notices to skip before returning rows (default: 0)

tools.name: GetFundNcenReports
tools.title: Fund Operations (Form N-CEN)
tools.description: Get operational data for a registered investment company from its SEC Form N-CEN annual reports. Accepts an exchange-listed ticker or an exact fund identifier from SearchFunds, including a profile id, SEC series id, stored series ticker, or verified share-class alias. Each N-CEN shows the registrant's classification, Investment Company Act file number, reporting period, first/last-filing flags, latest service providers, and an exact filed-name provider history. N-CEN is filed at registrant level; this dataset currently ingests it through tracked issuer feeds, so a series inside an untracked multi-series trust can resolve correctly but still have no N-CEN report on record. Only registered funds file N-CEN; operating companies return no data.

fund.description: Fund or ETF ticker, profile id, SEC series id, or verified share-class alias (e.g., MXF, IVV, S000004344, VOO)

maxResults.description: Maximum number of annual reports to return (default: 10, max: 500)

tools.name: GetFundProfile
tools.title: Fund Profile and Top Holdings
tools.description: Get a registered fund's profile and largest stored holdings from its latest SEC Form NPORT-P report. Accepts a profile ID, SEC series ID, stored ticker, or verified alias from SearchFunds. Returns registrant, series, assets, reported and stored holding counts, and the largest stored positions. Some multi-series trusts store only tracked-stock positions; reported counts and asset totals still describe the full filing. A row the report marks as securities-lending cash collateral is labelled in its category, and one line totals those rows. Use GetFundsHoldingStock for the inverse lookup.

fund.description: Fund profile id, SEC series id, stored series ticker, or verified share-class alias from SearchFunds (e.g., 'ishares-russell-2000-etf-s000004344', 'S000004344', 'IWM', or 'VOO').

maxResults.description: Maximum number of holdings to return, largest first (default: 20, max: 500)

offset.description: Number of ranked holdings to skip before returning rows (default: 0)

tools.name: GetFundsHoldingStock
tools.title: Funds Holding a Stock
tools.description: Get the registered investment companies (mutual funds and ETFs) holding an exact stock or ETF listing, from SEC Form NPORT-P portfolio reports. The listed security's authoritative CUSIP (or, for a listing on another exchange written MIC:TICKER, its ISIN) is matched against the holding rows on each fund series' most recent report (series that stopped filing more than 18 months ago are excluded), so an exited position never shows as current. Returns the fund's registrant and series, the reporting period, the position size, its U.S.-dollar value, its share of the fund's net assets and the payoff profile (Long/Short), largest positions first. Report dates differ per fund series (each files on its own fiscal quarter), so values are as of each row's report date and cross-row totals mix as-of dates.

ticker.description: Listed security ticker (e.g., AAPL, VOO); a listing on another exchange is MIC:TICKER (XPAR:AIR).

maxResults.description: Maximum number of fund positions to return, largest first (default: 20, clamped to 1-500)

registrantOrSeries.description: Optional registrant or series name filter (case-insensitive contains, e.g. 'Vanguard') — reaches positions beyond the largest 500

offset.description: Number of matching fund positions to skip before returning rows (default: 0)

tools.name: GetGoingConcernStatus
tools.title: Going-Concern Doubt Status
tools.description: Get a company's going-concern doubt status: whether its latest examined SEC filing states substantial doubt about the company's ability to continue as a going concern, with the verbatim disclosure, the filing it came from, and the history of examined filings showing when doubt appeared, was alleviated, or cleared. Flags are extracted from each company's newest 10-K/10-Q narrative text and verified before publication; a filing without going-concern language counts as no doubt. Coverage starts when the extraction lane first examined the company — earlier filings are not analyzed, so absence from the history does not rule out prior doubt episodes.

ticker.description: Stock ticker symbol (e.g., AAPL, MSFT).

tools.name: GetGovernmentContracts
tools.title: Federal Contracts by Company
tools.description: Get federal government contract awards won by a specific public company: US federal awards (from USAspending.gov) or Government of Canada contracts (from its proactive publication of contracts over C$10,000). Shows the award (action) date, recipient named by the government, awarding agency or department, total value (US: obligated dollars plus unexercised ceiling; Canada: contract value including amendments, in Canadian dollars; never revenue received), outlays when reported, end date, and description. Coverage: US prime contract awards of $1M or more, and Canadian contracts reported from fiscal 2017-2018 (April 2017) whose vendor name exactly matches a company listed on a Canadian exchange, so sums understate government revenue. Use GetTopGovernmentContractors to rank companies market-wide.

ticker.description: Stock ticker symbol (e.g., LMT, RTX, BA), or MIC:TICKER for a Canadian listing (e.g., XTSE:CAE)

startDate.description: Start date in YYYY-MM-DD format, filtering on the award action date (defaults to 1 year ago)

endDate.description: End date in YYYY-MM-DD format (defaults to today)

maxResults.description: Maximum number of awards to return (default: 50)

sortBy.description: Sort order: 'amount' (largest total value first, default) or 'date' (most recent award first)

agency.description: Optional case-insensitive substring filter on the awarding agency (e.g., 'Defense')

offset.description: Number of matching awards to skip before returning rows (default: 0)

country.description: Awarding government: US or CA. Defaults to the country of the listing the symbol names (CA for XTSE:CAE, US for a bare US ticker)

tools.name: GetGuidance
tools.title: Company Guidance
tools.description: Get company guidance from written Item 2.02 earnings releases and earnings-call transcripts, newest release first, with range, unit, GAAP basis, fiscal period and source provenance. Shows the newest 8 releases by default (about two years); maxReleases reaches older ones and fiscalYear narrows to the guidance for one fiscal year. Closed target periods are marked ended. Revenue and diluted-EPS guidance includes the reported actual and verdict once comparable XBRL facts exist; non-GAAP guidance is never compared with GAAP actuals. Coverage notes distinguish unprocessed documents from sources that state no guidance.

ticker.description: Stock ticker symbol (e.g., AAPL, MSFT), or MIC:TICKER (e.g., XPAR:AIR) for a listing outside the US.

maxReleases.description: Number of releases to show, newest first (default: 8, clamped to 1-200). Pass a larger number for older guidance.

fiscalYear.description: Optional fiscal year on the company's own calendar (e.g., 2026): only guidance for a period in that year, from every release that gave it.

tools.name: GetHolderMix
tools.title: 13F Holder Mix
tools.description: Who holds a stock or ETF listing, by kind of 13F filer, quarter by quarter: each bucket's share of 13F common shares, its like-for-like change, and new and exited filers. Split by holder type (regulatory records, never names), measured style, turnover, horizon, 13F book size, client base, private funds or location. Also gives the active holders' like-for-like change, which leaves index-like books out. The fundtype dimension instead splits registered funds' Form NPORT-P positions by their Form N-CEN fund type (index funds, index ETFs, active ETFs, active funds, unclassified) as a share of shares outstanding; fund positions sit inside their advisers' 13F reports, so they are never added to 13F totals.

ticker.description: Listed security ticker (e.g., NVDA, VOO)

dimension.description: How to split the holders: type (holder type, default), style, turnover, horizon, aum (13F book size), client (client base), pf (private funds), country (filer location), fundtype (registered funds by N-CEN fund type, from N-PORT, as a share of shares outstanding)

maxPeriods.description: Quarters to show, newest last (default 4, clamped to 1-12)

tools.name: GetHolderTargets
