tools.title: Shareholder Targets
tools.description: Shareholder targeting for a stock: the 13F filers of the newest closed quarter that hold its holder-overlap peers (operating companies whose active holders overlap most, funds excluded) but hold no class of the stock itself, ranked by the money they have in those peers. A stock with no overlap peers falls back to its sector's largest operating-company 13F holdings; a fund has no targets. Each target shows its 13F book, the peers' share of it, the peers it holds most of, its measured style and its holder type from regulatory records.

ticker.description: Listed security ticker (e.g., NVDA)

sort.description: Rank by: 'peerValue' (default, dollars held in the peers) or 'peerWeight' (the peers' share of the filer's 13F book, then book size)

maxResults.description: Maximum number of targets to return (default 25, clamped to 1-500)

tools.name: GetHolderTypeFlows
tools.title: 13F Holder Flows
tools.description: Market-wide 13F money flows for a closed quarter by kind of filer: what each bucket bought and sold, net flow, net flow as % of its prior 13F book, and net buyers vs sellers. Buckets: holder type (regulatory records, never names), measured style, turnover, horizon, book size, client base, private funds or location. Optionally split by sector, with ETFs apart. Trades are priced at quarter-average prices; filers with no 13F the quarter before add no flow.

dimension.description: How to split the filers: type (holder type, default), style, turnover, horizon, aum (13F book size), client (client base), pf (private funds), country (filer location)

reportDate.description: Closed quarter-end report date in YYYY-MM-DD format (defaults to the newest computed quarter; a later date reads the newest computed quarter, an earlier off-quarter date the computed quarter before it)

groupBy.description: none (default) or sector: split each bucket's flow by sector

bucket.description: One bucket token of the dimension (e.g. adv, idx, high) to list that bucket's flow by sector; implies groupBy=sector

tools.name: GetIndexChanges
tools.title: Index Additions and Deletions
tools.description: Get the companies that have joined or left a major US stock index, newest first. Changes are derived by comparing consecutive constituent lists from the funds that track the index, so each one is dated to the window between two reports rather than to an announcement: a daily holdings file dates a change to a day, a quarterly filing only to a quarter. Several funds track the same index and each records a change separately, so records for the same company and direction over overlapping windows are collapsed into the single event a reader should see, keeping the narrowest window. This is observed membership, not an announcement feed, so a change appears once a tracking fund has actually reported it. Each addition carries an estimate, not a record, of the index-fund buying it implied, in shares and days of volume.

index.description: Index name or slug, for example "S&P 500", "sp-500", "nasdaq-100" or "Russell 2000".

maxResults.description: Maximum changes to return, newest first (default 25, max 500).

tools.name: GetIndexComposition
tools.title: Index Constituents
tools.description: Get the current constituent list of a major US or Canadian stock index: S&P 500, S&P MidCap 400, S&P SmallCap 600, Nasdaq-100, Russell 1000, Russell 2000, the Dow Jones Industrial Average, the S&P/TSX 60, S&P/TSX Composite, S&P/TSX Venture Composite and the S&P/TSX capped sector indexes. Each row carries the company's rank by weight, its ticker, and its share of the index. A US list is a full-replication tracking fund's own disclosed holdings, taken from an SEC Form N-PORT filing or from the holdings file the fund publishes daily; a Canadian list is the constituent list TMX Money publishes under the index's symbol; the answer names which source and which date it came from. A partial filing is never served as a shrunken index. Rows not matched to a tracked company keep the name the source reported instead of being dropped. Use GetIndexChanges for what has joined or left, and GetIndexForecast for who the published rules point to next.

index.description: Index name or slug, for example "S&P 500", "sp-500", "nasdaq-100", "Russell 2000" or "S&P/TSX 60".

maxResults.description: Maximum constituents to return, heaviest first (default 100, max 500).

offset.description: Rows to skip before returning, for paging through a full list (default 0).

tools.name: GetIndexForecast
tools.title: Index Rebalance Forecast
tools.description: Apply an index's published entry rules and return candidates with rule-by-rule evidence. S&P results are SCREENS because a committee chooses additions; the S&P 500 adds versioned 90-day empirical join probabilities for eligible candidates and exit probabilities for every member. They are estimates, not guarantees. Russell and Nasdaq-100 are PROJECTIONS decided by published rankings. A non-member with a missing figure has no entry verdict. An unmeasured member stays out of deterministic departure buckets, while the S&P 500 gives it the neutral exit baseline. The Dow has no quantitative rule or forecast. Each model revision is immutable. A model-version change may append a higher revision for the same trading day, and readers use the highest revision.

index.description: Index name or slug, for example "S&P 500", "nasdaq-100" or "Russell 2000". The Dow is not forecastable.

maxResults.description: Maximum companies to return per bucket (default 25, max 1000).

tools.name: GetIndexFundFlows
tools.title: Index Fund Flows and Rebalance Trades
tools.description: Get the money flowing into or out of the fund that tracks an index, and what that fund bought and sold for the index at its last rebalance. Covers the indexes whose tracking fund publishes a daily holdings file, such as the S&P 500 (IVV), S&P MidCap 400 (IJH), S&P SmallCap 600 (IJR), Russell 1000 (IWB) and Russell 2000 (IWM). A flow is an estimate: creating or redeeming units scales every holding alike, so the median change in the fund's share counts between two daily files is its flow, applied to the fund's value. It is that one fund's money, not demand for the index. A rebalance is the newest session where at least one holding in ten moved more than 2% apart from the fund's flow; those holdings were traded for the index itself. The trade lists rank every holding more than 0.1% apart from the flow by dollar value, so a small adjustment to a large company can lead them. Use GetIndexChanges for the companies that joined or left.

index.description: Index name or slug, for example "S&P 500", "sp-500", "S&P MidCap 400" or "Russell 2000".

tools.name: GetInsiderOwnership
tools.title: Insider Ownership Summary
tools.description: Get a summary of insider ownership for a stock, ranked by total shares held. Shares come from each insider's most recent SEC Form 3/4/5 filing: the filing's closing balance per security, held directly or through each indirect vehicle the filing names (a trust, partnership or LLC, told apart by its stated nature of ownership and by which balance each trade continues), actual shares only (options and other derivative holdings are excluded), summed into Direct and Indirect columns and restated onto today's split basis, so they can differ from the raw figures in older filings. A vehicle the newest filing does not list is not counted. Last Transaction is the newest trade that filing reports, or Holding when it reports positions only. Former insiders may linger with stale dates or zero shares. Returns at most maxResults insiders (default 30). Use this to understand the insider ownership structure of a company; use GetInsiderTransactions for the underlying trades.

ticker.description: Company ticker symbol (e.g., AAPL, MSFT)

maxResults.description: Maximum number of insiders to return (default: 30, max: 500; values outside 1-500 are clamped)

offset.description: Number of ranked insiders to skip before returning rows (default: 0, clamped to 0-100000). For the next page, add the returned row count to the clamped current offset; if the next offset exceeds 100000, narrow the filters instead. Stop when fewer than the effective page size (maxResults clamped to 1-500) are returned, or the response's total has been reached.

tools.name: GetInsiderSentimentScores
tools.title: Insider Sentiment Scores
tools.description: Rank stocks by a peer-relative 0-100 insider-accumulation score over 90 days: net buyers, net shares bought as a percent of shares outstanding, and net buy value. It uses qualifying open-market Forms 4/5 purchases and sales by officers and directors (a holder that is only a 10% owner is excluded); Form 3 establishes initial ownership, and disclosed Rule 10b5-1 trades are excluded. Filter for cluster buys or liquidity, request the bottom ranking for distribution, or pass ticker for one stock's factors and universe rank. Filters never renumber the universe rank. Use GetInsiderTransactions for the filings.

clusterBuysOnly.description: Return only stocks flagged as cluster buys (three or more distinct insiders buying in the window).

minMarketCap.description: Minimum market capitalization in US dollars (e.g. 300000000 = $300M; default 0 = no floor). Stocks with an unknown market cap are excluded when set.

minSharePrice.description: Minimum share price in US dollars (e.g. 5 = $5; default 0 = no floor). Stocks with an unknown price are excluded when set.

minDollarVolume.description: Minimum trailing 3-month average daily dollar volume in US dollars (e.g. 5000000 = $5M/day; default 0 = no floor). Stocks with unknown volume are excluded when set.

maxResults.description: Maximum number of stocks to return (default: 25, highest score first; clamped to 1-200).

bottom.description: Return the LOWEST-scored stocks instead — the heaviest peer-relative net insider selling — lowest score first.

ticker.description: Optional stock ticker (e.g. NVDA): returns that one stock's score, factor breakdown, and rank within the scored universe instead of the leaderboard. The other filters do not apply to a single-ticker lookup.

offset.description: Number of matching ranked stocks to skip before returning rows (default: 0; ignored for a single-ticker lookup).

tools.name: GetInsiderTransactions
tools.title: Insider Transactions (Forms 4/5)
tools.description: Get recent insider trading transactions for a stock from SEC Forms 4 and 5, newest first. Form 3 supplies initial ownership rather than a transaction. Type is the SEC transaction code: 'Buy'/'Sell' are open-market purchases/sales only, while Award, Exercise/Conversion (SEC code M: a derivative exercised or converted into shares, typically a stock-option exercise; filter value Conversion), Exercise (code X), Tax Payment, Expiration, Gift, Inheritance, Discretionary and Other are compensation or derivative mechanics, not conviction trades. 10b5-1 marks trades under a pre-arranged Rule 10b5-1 plan ('-' = filing predates the 2023 checkbox). Date is the transaction day; Filed is the day its Form 4 or 5 reached the SEC, when the trade became public. Shares/Price/Value are as filed; Owned After is the post-transaction balance on today's split basis, per security kind and ownership form. Optional date-range, transaction-type and insider-name filters reach history beyond the newest rows.

ticker.description: Company ticker symbol (e.g., AAPL, MSFT)

maxResults.description: Maximum number of transactions to return (default: 50, max: 500; values outside 1-500 are clamped)

fromDate.description: Only include transactions on or after this date, format yyyy-MM-dd (optional)

toDate.description: Only include transactions on or before this date, format yyyy-MM-dd (optional)

transactionType.description: Only include one transaction type: Buy, Sell, Award, Conversion (SEC code M, option exercises included), Exercise (code X), TaxPayment, Expiration, Gift, Inheritance, Discretionary or Other (optional)

insiderName.description: Only include transactions by insiders whose SEC-filed name contains every word of this value, case-insensitive (e.g. 'Huang') (optional)

offset.description: Number of matching transactions to skip before returning rows (default: 0)

tools.name: GetInstitutionBeneficialOwnership
tools.title: Institution 13D and 13G Stakes
tools.description: Get the Schedule 13D and 13G stakes a named institution has disclosed: its latest filing on each listed security (13D or 13G, amendment or not) with the event and filing dates, accession, the shares (restated onto today's split basis) and percent of class, the change since the filer's previous filing on that security, a 13D's Item 4 purpose where described, and a status: current; unconfirmed (no filing in 24 months; a 13D or 13G stays in force until amended, so the stake is kept and never assumed sold); below 5% (the final amendment that ends the filer's duty to amend, not necessarily the holding); exited (no shares); or security retired (the issuer no longer trades in the US). Current and unconfirmed stakes list by default; includeHistory adds the rest. These are event-dated 5% stakes, not a quarter-end portfolio: GetInstitutionPortfolio covers the 13F book. Resolve exact CIKs with SearchInstitutions; a filer that files only 13D or 13G resolves too.

institutionName.description: Institution name or CIK (a unique partial resolves; ambiguous partials return candidate CIKs)

includeHistory.description: Also list stakes reported below 5%, exited, or on securities that no longer trade (default: false)

maxResults.description: Maximum number of stakes to return (default: 20, clamped to 1-500)

offset.description: Number of stakes to skip before returning results (default: 0)

tools.name: GetInstitutionCloneBacktest
tools.title: 13F Portfolio Clone Backtest
tools.description: Backtest how cloning an institutional filer's reported 13F portfolio would have performed against a market benchmark, either over a trailing window (windowYears) or an explicit fromDate/toDate range. Reconstructs the filer's portfolio at each quarterly 13F snapshot, rebalances on the SEC filing lag, and values each exact listed security on raw closing prices. Returns price return (dividends excluded), CAGR, and max drawdown for the clone and benchmark, plus price-return alpha. Returns are unavailable when a held security or benchmark crosses a captured split without a certified price basis; the requested window is not shortened to hide it.

institution.description: Institution name or SEC CIK (e.g., 'Berkshire Hathaway', '1067983', or zero-padded '0001067983'). Unique partials and verified aliases resolve; ambiguous partials return candidate CIKs.

benchmark.description: Benchmark ticker to compare against (default: SPY)

windowYears.description: Trailing window length in years anchored at today (default: 3, clamped to 1-20; ignored when fromDate/toDate are supplied)

fromDate.description: Optional window start in YYYY-MM-DD format for an anchored historical backtest (e.g. 2015-01-01); overrides windowYears

toDate.description: Optional window end in YYYY-MM-DD format (defaults to today when only fromDate is given)

tools.name: GetInstitutionConsensusHoldings
tools.title: Consensus Holdings Across Institutions
tools.description: Combine 2-25 institutions' 13F portfolios on their latest common report date. Ranks stocks by holder count, then combined value. Counts common shares only; puts, calls and principal amounts are left out. Published values normally use report-date closing prices, may fall back to filer values, and can be zero when unavailable. Set minInstitutions to 2 or more for positions shared by multiple filers.

institutionNames.description: Institution names or CIKs (2-25). Unique partial names and verified aliases resolve; ambiguous partials return candidate CIKs.

reportDate.description: Quarter-end 13F report date in YYYY-MM-DD format (defaults to the latest common quarter; an off-quarter date snaps to the nearest common report on or before it)

minInstitutions.description: Minimum number of institutions that must hold a stock (default: 1; set 2 or more for shared positions)

maxResults.description: Maximum number of stocks to return (default: 30, clamped to 1-500)

tools.name: GetInstitutionPortfolio
tools.title: Institution Portfolio (13F)
tools.description: View the tracked stock positions of a specific institutional investor from an SEC 13F-HR filing. Shows the largest positions by published value (default 20, max 500), with share counts, value, percent of tracked 13F value, and position count. Values normally use report-date closing prices, may fall back to filer values, and can be zero when unavailable. Coverage is limited to tracked U.S.-listed common stocks and related put/call positions; use position type before treating options as ownership. Use SearchInstitutions first when the name is ambiguous. The answer names the 13F filing behind the quarter shown: its SEC filing date and when it was loaded.

institutionName.description: Institution name or SEC CIK. A unique partial name resolves; an ambiguous partial returns candidate CIKs instead of selecting silently.

reportDate.description: Quarter-end 13F report date in YYYY-MM-DD format (defaults to the holder's latest; an off-quarter date snaps to the nearest report on or before it)

maxResults.description: Maximum number of holdings to return (default: 20, clamped to 1-500)

offset.description: Number of ranked holding rows to skip before returning rows (default: 0, clamped to 0-100000). For the next page, add the returned row count to the clamped current offset; if the next offset exceeds 100000, narrow the filters instead. Stop when fewer than the effective page size (maxResults clamped to 1-500) are returned, or the response's total has been reached.

tools.name: GetInstitutionQuarterlyActivity
tools.title: Institution Quarterly Activity
tools.description: Get an institution's quarterly position-change activity — Initiated / Increased / Reduced / Exited stocks diffed against the immediately prior quarter. Common shares, put/call positions and principal amounts are separate rows labelled by Type. Returns the buckets as one markdown section per bucket, sorted by absolute Δ market-value desc (Δ Value includes price movement, not just trading). Use `bucket` to filter to a single bucket. Use this to answer 'what did this fund do this quarter?' The answer names the 13F filing behind the quarter shown: its SEC filing date and when it was loaded.

institutionName.description: Institution name or CIK (a unique partial resolves; ambiguous partials return candidate CIKs)

reportDate.description: Quarter-end 13F report date in YYYY-MM-DD format (defaults to the holder's latest; an off-quarter date snaps to the nearest report on or before it)

bucket.description: Filter to a single bucket: initiated, increased, reduced, exited (omit for all four)

maxResults.description: Maximum number of stocks to return per bucket (default: 20, clamped to 1-500)

tools.name: GetInstitutionSectorAllocation
tools.title: Institution Sector Allocation
tools.description: Get an institution's 13F portfolio allocation for a given report quarter (defaults to the latest), grouped by fine-grained industry (default) or rolled up by sector via `groupBy`. Returns a markdown table sorted by % of portfolio descending, with stocks lacking a classification collapsed into a single 'Unclassified' row at the end. Published values normally use report-date closing prices, may fall back to filer values, and can be zero when unavailable. Use SearchInstitutions for an exact CIK; ambiguous partial names return candidates instead of selecting silently.

institutionName.description: Institution name or CIK (a unique partial resolves; ambiguous partials return candidate CIKs)

reportDate.description: Quarter-end 13F report date in YYYY-MM-DD format (defaults to the holder's latest; an off-quarter date snaps to the nearest report on or before it)

tools.name: GetInstitutionStyleHistory
tools.title: Institution Style History
tools.description: Get an institutional 13F filer's portfolio style quarter by quarter, measured from its filed common-share book: style band (index-like, systematic-like, concentrated, diversified active), turnover band, holding-horizon band, and the measurements behind them (equity value, stock count, active share against every 13F filer's combined book and against the closest benchmark among the S&P 500, S&P MidCap 400, S&P SmallCap 600, Russell 1000, Russell 2000, Nasdaq-100 and Dow Jones Industrial Average with its as-of date, sector active share, top 10 weight, effective positions, trailing annual turnover, value-weighted holding period), plus the newest quarter's active share against every benchmark. Bands are measurements with stated thresholds, never the firm's own description. Closed quarters only; the newest quarter is measured once its filing window closes.

institutionName.description: Institution name or CIK (a unique partial resolves; ambiguous partials return candidate CIKs)

maxPeriods.description: Number of measured quarters to return, newest first (default: 8, clamped to 1-40)

tools.name: GetInstitutionSummary
tools.title: Institution Portfolio Summary
tools.description: Get the portfolio summary header for an institutional 13F filer — published tracked 13F value (not total firm AUM), position count, top-10 / top-25 concentration, QoQ turnover, and the latest / prior report dates with the count of quarters tracked, then the holder's profile from regulatory records: entity type and the record that decided it, Form ADV adviser facts (regulatory assets, client base, private funds, LEI) with roster history and dated Schedule D private funds, registered funds it advises, the parent 13F filer that reports its holdings, and earlier or later CIKs its 13F reports continue under, then any strategy the firm states in its own filed brochure (quoted, dated, linked), then its style, turnover and horizon bands measured from its filed book. Values use report-date closing prices, may fall back to filer values, and can be zero when unvalued. Resolve exact CIKs with SearchInstitutions; ambiguous partial names return candidates rather than selecting a filer silently.

institutionName.description: Institution name or CIK (a unique partial resolves; ambiguous partials return candidate CIKs)

reportDate.description: Quarter-end 13F report date in YYYY-MM-DD format (defaults to the holder's latest; an off-quarter date snaps to the nearest report on or before it)

tools.name: GetInstitutionalOwnershipHistory
tools.title: Institutional Ownership History
tools.description: Get the historical trend of institutional (13F) ownership for an exact stock or ETF listing across multiple quarters. Shows total shares, published position value, and filer count. Total Shares and Total Value count common-share positions only; put, call and principal rows are left out, since they are not shares held. The filer count includes every 13F filer reporting any position, options included. Share Chg (QoQ) is like-for-like: it compares only filers with an observed 13F in both quarters, and each quarter notes the filers and shares it excluded (largest named) and names prior holders whose book is under SEC confidential treatment, so missing filings and identity changes are not trades. Values normally use report-date closing prices, may fall back to filer values, and can include zero when unavailable. While the newest quarter's filing window is open, non-ETF primary stocks use a provisional combined view; ETF listings remain exact and as-filed because carry-forward is filer-wide.

ticker.description: Listed security ticker (e.g., AAPL, VOO)

maxPeriods.description: Maximum number of quarterly periods to return (default: 8, clamped to 1-500)

tools.name: GetIntradayStockPrices
tools.title: Intraday Stock Prices
tools.description: Get intraday price bars for ONE stock or ETF, newest first: open, high, low, close, volume and trades, with VWAP on 1-minute bars; use for backtests. GetStockPrices has daily bars, GetLiveQuote the latest price. interval is any whole minutes from 1min (default) to 240min, or 1hour to 4hour, counted from the exchange's midnight. Defaults to the last 7 days (30 for hourly); startDate and endDate set another, back to 2016 where stored. session is regular (default) or extended (04:00 to 20:00 New York). adjustment is split (default) or raw (as traded). A period without trades has no bar. A cut answer names the next endTime. Plus gets a US bar 15 minutes after it ends, Pro as it forms, Free an upgrade note. Outside the US use MIC:TICKER: Euronext (XPAR:AIR) is order-book trades only, added next day; Canada (XTSE:RY, XTSX, XCNQ) ends at 15:59 Toronto, below daily volume; NSE (XNSE:RELIANCE), the exchange's own series; BSE-only companies (XBOM), close and volume only; all added after close.

ticker.description: US stock or ETF ticker, e.g. AAPL, or MIC:TICKER outside the US, e.g. XPAR:AIR, XTSE:RY, XNSE:RELIANCE

interval.description: Bar size: whole minutes from 1min to 240min (e.g. 5min, 7min), or 1hour to 4hour (default: 1min)

startDate.description: First trading date on the exchange's clock in YYYY-MM-DD format (default: 7 days before the end, 30 for hourly intervals)

endDate.description: Last trading date on the exchange's clock in YYYY-MM-DD format (default: today)

endTime.description: Return only bars that start before this RFC 3339 time; replaces endDate

session.description: US trading hours: regular or extended (default: regular); ignored for a listing outside the US

adjustment.description: Price basis: split or raw (default: split)

maxResults.description: Maximum bars to return, newest first (default: 60, max: 500)

tools.name: GetInvestmentAdviser
tools.title: Investment Adviser Profile (Form ADV)
tools.description: Get the full Form ADV profile for a single SEC-registered or exempt reporting investment adviser by its Organization CRD number: legal and business names, SEC file number, main office, website, regulatory assets under management (discretionary, non-discretionary and total), employee count, and how the firm is compensated (fee structure); exempt reporting advisers do not report these Item 5 figures. Find CRD numbers with SearchInvestmentAdvisers.

tools.name: GetInvestorEventSlideMetadata
tools.title: Investor Event Slide Metadata
tools.description: Get metadata and access links for a captured investor-event slide deck by event id. Returns the same deck metadata as REST: event and ticker, call date, deck title and source, PDF versus image-slideshow kind, page count, capture time, MIME type, and either the deck's public PDF URL or its ordered public slide-image URLs, which open in a browser without an API key. The binary PDF/image contents are not embedded in the response. Get the event id from ListInvestorEvents or GetEarningsCallEvent.

eventId.description: The investor event id (from ListInvestorEvents or GetEarningsCallEvent)

tools.name: GetInvestorEventTranscript
tools.title: Investor Event Transcript
tools.description: Get the speaker-labelled transcript of a specific investor event (earnings call, conference, investor day) by its event id — every speaker turn in order, attributed to the real person (executive or analyst) with their role when the resolution is trusted; unverified voices show as a role label (e.g. Operator) or a neutral speaker number. Get the event id from ListInvestorEvents. Use this for conferences and other non-earnings events, which have no fiscal quarter to key on.

limit.description: Maximum number of speaker turns to return (default 50, max 200; values outside 1-200 are clamped)

offset.description: Number of leading speaker turns to skip, for paging through events longer than the 200-turn cap (default 0)

tools.name: GetInvestorRelationsNews
tools.title: Investor Relations News
tools.description: Get recent investor-relations press releases for a stock, scraped from the company's IR website; for a US company whose IR site has no news feed, the press releases it furnished as exhibits to its 8-K filings, each marked as such. Returns the most recent news items (headline, publish date, summary when the source provides one, and link) in reverse-chronological order. Use this to see a company's latest official announcements straight from its IR page, distinct from third-party news. Coverage is partial — only companies whose IR page has been discovered and content-scraped have items, so an empty answer may be a coverage gap rather than corporate silence; the response says which case applies.

ticker.description: Company ticker symbol (e.g., NVDA), or MIC:TICKER (e.g., XPAR:AIR) for a listing outside the US.

maxResults.description: Maximum number of news items to return (default: 20, max: 500)

since.description: Optional earliest publish date, strict yyyy-MM-dd (UTC). Only items published on or after this date are returned.

offset.description: Number of matching news items to skip before returning rows (default: 0).

tools.name: GetIpoDetails
tools.title: IPO Registration Details
tools.description: Get one S-1/F-1 registration's full picture by the filer's SEC CIK (as listed by GetIpoFeed): lifecycle status, verified offering classification, effective-prospectus accession and its equibles.com page, proposed ticker and exchange, the offer price range and shares offered with their verbatim prospectus quotes, what the company does, how it will use the proceeds, the underwriting banks in cover order, the key summary risk factors (each with its verbatim prospectus sentence), the annual pre-IPO financials from the filer's own XBRL-tagged statements, and the complete S-1/amendment/prospectus filing chain, each stored filing with its equibles.com page. Underwriter and risk-factor availability distinguishes pending/rejected extraction from a completed read that stated none. Everything extracted is verified against the filing text and never estimated.

cik.description: The filer's SEC CIK, with or without leading zeros (e.g. 1995137).

tools.name: GetIpoFeed
tools.title: IPO Feed
tools.description: Get the US S-1/F-1 registration pipeline, newest filing activity first. Rows distinguish Primary, Resale, DirectListing, NonOffering and Unknown transactions; terms come from the newest effective prospectus or latest filing and never a superseded document. Results include lifecycle, proposed listing, applicable offer terms and latest annual XBRL financials in the filer's currency. Filter lifecycle or SEC-classified SPAC versus operating filers. Use a row's CIK with GetIpoDetails for the filing chain and extracted detail.

status.description: Optional lifecycle filter: Filed, Priced, Listed, or Withdrawn. Omit for all.

filerType.description: Optional company-type filter: Operating (non-SPAC) or Spac (SIC 6770 blank checks, as SEC classifies the filer or, until it does, as the registration statement states). Omit for all.

limit.description: Maximum registrations to return, newest filing activity first (default 25).

offset.description: Number of matching registrations to skip before returning rows (default 0).

tools.name: GetLargestShortVolume
tools.title: Largest Short Volume by Day
tools.description: Get the exact listed securities, including ETFs, with the largest daily short sale volume for a single trading day (defaults to the latest available), from FINRA's daily short sale volume files, sorted by short volume descending. Short % is the share of that day's FINRA-facility (off-exchange/TRF) volume sold short — 40-50% is a normal market-making baseline — NOT short interest (the open short position; use GetShortInterest/GetShortInterestSnapshot for positions and GetShortSqueezeScores for operating-stock squeeze candidates; use GetShortVolume for one listed security's daily history). Pass sortBy=shortPercent with a minTotalVolume floor to rank by short intensity instead of raw size.

date.description: Trading day in YYYY-MM-DD format (defaults to the latest available day)

maxResults.description: Maximum number of results to return (default: 50, max: 500)

offset.description: Number of ranked results to skip before returning rows (default: 0, clamped to 0-100000). For the next page, add the returned row count to the clamped current offset; if the next offset exceeds 100000, narrow the filters instead. Stop when fewer than the effective page size (maxResults clamped to 1-500) are returned, or the response's total has been reached.

sortBy.description: Sort key: shortVolume (default) or shortPercent — with shortPercent set a minTotalVolume floor, otherwise illiquid names dominate

minTotalVolume.description: Minimum total FINRA-reported volume filter, in shares (default: 0 = no floor)

tools.name: GetLatest13FFilings
tools.title: Latest 13F Filings
tools.description: List the newest SEC 13F-HR filings loaded here, newest filing day first: filer, CIK, report quarter, SEC filing date, when the filing was loaded (UTC), original or amendment, tracked positions and tracked value. Opens with how many filings are loaded per recent filing day and when the newest of them was loaded, so you can tell whether a quarter's filings are in before reading a filer's holdings. Filter by reportDate (a quarter end) or filedSince. A filing appears only after it is filed with the SEC and loaded; a filer absent from the list has no newer 13F on file here.

reportDate.description: Quarter-end 13F report date in YYYY-MM-DD format to list only that quarter's filings (omit for every quarter)

filedSince.description: Earliest SEC filing date in YYYY-MM-DD format (omit for no lower bound)

maxResults.description: Maximum number of filings to return (default: 20, clamped to 1-500)

offset.description: Number of filings to skip before returning rows (default: 0, clamped to 0-100000). For the next page, add the returned row count to the current offset.

tools.name: GetLatestCftcPositioning
tools.title: Latest CFTC Positioning Snapshot
tools.description: Get the latest COT positioning snapshot across all tracked futures contracts, grouped by category (Agriculture, Energy, Metals, Equity Indices, Interest Rates, Currencies). Shows commercial and non-commercial net positions in contract counts from the legacy futures-only COT report (positions as of each Tuesday, published Friday). Each row carries the market code accepted by GetCftcPositioning.

category.description: Category filter: Agriculture, Energy, Metals, EquityIndices, InterestRates, Currencies (defaults to all)

tools.name: GetLatestClosingPrices
tools.title: Latest Closing Prices
tools.description: Get each ticker's newest traded, settled daily close (USD for US listings; a MIC:TICKER listing on another exchange in its own trading currency, named in a note), with one-session change, volume, and trailing 52-week closing range. Rows can have different dates while a session settles; use the Date column. Change is omitted when the immediately prior trading session is absent; for a MIC:TICKER row it compares with the previous traded close, omitted when that close is more than 12 days older or a stored session in between shows no trades. Split-limited or partial 52-week ranges are marked in the response. This is settled history, not an intraday quote.

tickers.description: Ticker symbols (max 25). Class shares may use BRK-B or BRK.B; a listing on another exchange is MIC:TICKER (XPAR:AIR).

tools.name: GetLatestEconomicIndicators
tools.title: Latest Economic Indicators
tools.description: Get the latest values for key economic indicators across categories: interest rates, yield spreads, inflation, employment, GDP, money supply, sentiment, housing, exchange rates, market indicators, and government debt and deficits. Each row shows a series' latest stored observation with its date, plus the previous observation and the change between them for direction — check the Latest Date column for freshness. Returns a snapshot of current macro conditions for one country: the United States by default, or Canada with country=CA.

category.description: Category filter: InterestRates, YieldSpreads, CorporateBondSpreads, Inflation, Employment, GdpAndOutput, MoneySupply, Sentiment, Housing, ExchangeRates, Market, GovernmentFinance (defaults to all)

country.description: Country as an ISO code: US (default) or CA. A snapshot never mixes two countries' series.

tools.name: GetLiveQuote
tools.title: Live Stock Quote
tools.description: Get the latest intraday reading for active U.S. listings (consolidated SIP: last trade, UTC time, freshness, bid/ask, session, the regular close once settled, change from the previous close, day volume) and for MIC:TICKER listings on a Canadian exchange (XTSE, XTSX, XCNQ, NEOE; e.g. XTSE:RY), Euronext (XPAR, XAMS, XBRU, XMSM, XOSL, MTAA, XLIS; e.g. XPAR:AIR), NSE (e.g. XNSE:RELIANCE) or BSE (XBOM, BSE-only companies), in the listing's currency. Paid plans only: U.S. is real time on Pro, 15 minutes delayed on Plus; Canadian is real time on XTSE and XTSX, 15 minutes behind on XCNQ and NEOE; Euronext trails 15 minutes (Delayed=true); Indian readings are fetched on request (Delayed=true when trailing). A reading older than the settled daily close answers with that close, timed at the session's end. Free gets an upgrade note. Stale=true: the reading predates the session expected now. Missing readings are listed. Settled daily bars: GetLatestClosingPrices or GetStockPrices.

tickers.description: Ticker symbols (max 25): a bare ticker for a U.S. listing, MIC:TICKER for a Canadian, Euronext, NSE or BSE one.

tools.name: GetMajorShareholdings
tools.title: Major Shareholders
tools.description: Get the major-holding notifications regulators outside the US publish for one listing, written MIC:TICKER (e.g. XLON:BARC): who crossed a voting-rights threshold, when, and the resulting position. Coverage: the UK FCA (TR-1 under DTR 5), the French AMF, the Dutch AFM (no publication date stated), the Spanish CNMV (significant holdings), Japan's EDINET (large-shareholding reports; a joint report states its holders' total ratio) and Canada's securities regulators (early warning and alternative monthly reports from 10%, as a percentage of the class). Each row is one notification by the obligated person: voting rights through shares (direct and indirect) and financial instruments, the total, the share of capital where stated, and the previous notified total. Dated notifications, not a register, never summed or merged with SEC 13F, 13D or 13G data; a correction replaces the version it corrects. For a US listing use GetBeneficialOwnership (13D and 13G) and GetTopHolders (13F).

ticker.description: Listing symbol MIC:TICKER, e.g. XLON:BARC; a provider suffix such as BARC.L also works. A bare ticker names a US listing and is answered with the US ownership tools and the company's listings outside the US.

maxResults.description: Maximum notifications, newest event first (default 20, max 100).

offset.description: Rows to skip for paging (default 0).

tools.name: GetMarketHolidayCalendar
tools.title: US Market Holiday Calendar
tools.description: List the US equity market holidays and early-close (1:00 p.m. ET) half days for a calendar year (NYSE/Nasdaq). Defaults to the current year. The calendar is curated for 2025 through 2027; a year outside that range reports so rather than guessing.

year.description: Calendar year, e.g. 2026. Defaults to the current year.

tools.name: GetMarketStatus
tools.title: US Market Status
tools.description: Get the current US equity market status (NYSE/Nasdaq), evaluated in America/New_York: whether the market is open, the current session (pre-market, regular, after-hours, or closed), whether today is a full-day holiday or a 1:00 p.m. ET early close, today's regular and extended (pre-market/after-hours) trading hours, and the next open and next close. Backed by the exchange's curated holiday and early-close calendar, not a heuristic.

tools.name: GetMarketWide13FActivity
tools.title: Market-Wide 13F Activity
tools.description: Get the market-wide 13F leaderboards for a given quarter — which stocks were most bought, most sold, most initiated, or most exited across all 13F filers vs the prior quarter. The `bucket` argument selects one of: top-buys (Δ shares > 0 ranked by Δ value desc), top-sells (Δ shares < 0 ranked by Δ value asc), new-positions (stocks ranked by count of filers initiating a position), sold-out-positions (stocks ranked by count of filers exiting). Every board counts only filers with a 13F in both quarters. Δ Value is the change in published position value: values normally use report-date closing prices, may fall back to filer values, and can be zero when unavailable. It includes price movement on held shares, so use Δ Shares to read the position change itself. The output publishes the first complete 13F report quarter and refuses comparisons that cross that corpus boundary. Use this to answer 'what's the consensus 13F move this quarter?' Shares and value count common shares only.

bucket.description: Bucket: top-buys, top-sells, new-positions, or sold-out-positions

reportDate.description: Quarter-end 13F report date in YYYY-MM-DD format, e.g. 2026-03-31 (defaults to the latest available 13F quarter; an off-quarter date snaps to the nearest report on or before it)

maxResults.description: Maximum number of stocks to return (default: 20, clamped to 1-500)

tools.name: GetMarketWideCongressionalActivity
tools.title: Market-Wide Congressional Activity
tools.description: Get the stocks members of Congress traded most over a trailing window, aggregated across EVERY member and ticker — 'what did Congress buy this week' without needing a ticker or a member name. The window is anchored on the DISCLOSURE (filing) date because the STOCK Act's general outside filing deadline is 45 days after a trade; late or amended records can arrive later. Each row aggregates one stock's disclosed trades: distinct members buying and selling, trade counts, estimated dollar flow per direction (each disclosed amount range's midpoint — members disclose a band, not an exact figure), the largest participants, and the latest filing and transaction dates. direction=buys ranks by estimated net buying, direction=sells by estimated net selling; chamber=senate/house narrows to one chamber. Use GetCongressionalTrades for one stock's underlying disclosures and GetMemberTrades for one member's.

days.description: Trailing disclosure window in days (default: 30, max: 365).

direction.description: Ranking direction: 'buys' (most net congressional buying first, default) or 'sells' (most net selling first).

maxResults.description: Maximum number of stocks to return (default: 25, max: 200).

chamber.description: Filter by chamber: 'senate' or 'house' (defaults to both).

tools.name: GetMemberNetWorth
tools.title: Congress Member Net Worth
tools.description: Get a congress member's net worth history from their annual financial disclosures. Disclosed values are ranges, so every year is a band (minimum-maximum), never a point estimate. Only electronically filed reports are read: a missing year means no electronic filing, not zero net worth. Use SearchCongressMembers to find member names.

memberName.description: Congress member name, case-insensitive (e.g., 'Nancy Pelosi', 'Marsha Blackburn'); use SearchCongressMembers to find the exact name

maxResults.description: Maximum number of years to return (default: 20, max: 500, newest first)

tools.name: GetMemberTrades
tools.title: Trades by Congress Member
tools.description: Get a congress member's disclosed securities transactions (newest first, last year by default). Shows tickers, transaction and filing dates, disclosed amount ranges, the filed Asset identifying the instrument (such as stock, option, or bond), and the member's party on the transaction date. Use SearchCongressMembers to find member names, and GetCongressionalTrades for all members' transactions in one ticker.

memberName.description: Congress member name, case-insensitive (e.g., 'Nancy Pelosi', 'Dan Crenshaw'); use SearchCongressMembers to find the exact name

transactionType.description: Filter by transaction type: Purchase or Sale; the synonyms Buy/Sell are accepted (defaults to all)

startDate.description: Start date in YYYY-MM-DD format (defaults to 1 year ago)

endDate.description: End date in YYYY-MM-DD format (defaults to today)

maxResults.description: Maximum number of trades to return (default: 50, max: 500, newest first)

offset.description: Number of trades to skip before returning rows (default: 0, clamped to 0-100000). For the next page, add the returned row count to the clamped current offset; if the next offset exceeds 100000, narrow the filters instead. Stop when fewer than the effective page size (maxResults clamped to 1-500) are returned, or the response's total has been reached.

ticker.description: Optional stock ticker to combine with the member filter (e.g., AAPL)

tools.name: GetMostHeldStocks
tools.title: Most Widely Held Stocks
tools.description: Get the cross-sectional ranking of stocks by institutional 13F breadth for a quarter. Rank by filer count (default), quarter-over-quarter filer-count change, total published position value, conviction (filers holding it among their ten largest positions) or crowding (high-turnover and private-fund adviser shares as % of shares outstanding), both among stocks 10+ filers hold. Conviction and crowding read the newest closed quarter measured across every 13F book (an open or unmeasured quarter snaps to it, noted). Values use report-date closing prices, may fall back to filer values, and can be zero when unvalued. Includes Δ filers, total value, Δ value, and share of the 13F universe. The first complete report quarter is published; earlier rankings and boundary-quarter deltas are unavailable. Only currently-held stocks rank; sold-out names use GetMarketWide13FActivity. During the newest quarter's open filing window, non-filers carry prior-quarter positions (noted in output).

reportDate.description: Quarter-end 13F report date in YYYY-MM-DD format, e.g. 2026-03-31 (defaults to the latest available 13F quarter; an off-quarter date snaps to the nearest report on or before it)

sort.description: Sort by: 'filers' (default, # of 13F filers desc), 'filersDelta' (QoQ filer-count delta desc — warming names), 'filersDeltaAsc' (QoQ filer-count delta asc — cooling names), 'value' (current total published position value desc), 'conviction' (filers holding it among their ten largest positions desc) or 'crowding' (high-turnover and private-fund adviser shares as % of shares outstanding desc)

maxResults.description: Maximum number of stocks to return (default: 25, clamped to 1-500)

tools.name: GetMyPortfolio
tools.title: My Portfolio
tools.description: Get the caller's saved portfolios, and those colleagues shared with the caller's organization, including stock and option lots, cost basis, realized and unrealized profit, and watched instruments. Omit portfolio to list portfolios; if exactly one exists it is returned in full. Pass its name to select one; a shared portfolio whose name is also taken is named "Name (Creator)" in the list. Quantities are signed; costs are the owner's per-share inputs and are never split-restated. Each position is in its listing's currency; totals are in the portfolio's currency at the official rates named in the answer. Every mark names its session. Unpriceable and expired positions have unknown value, never zero. Watched instruments are not positions and must not be counted as exposure. Returned lot ids address the update, close and remove tools. Use GetInstitutionPortfolio for 13F holdings.

portfolio.description: Optional. The portfolio's name, as listed. Omit to list the portfolios.

tools.name: GetNonGaapBridge
tools.title: Non-GAAP to GAAP Bridge

tools.name: GetOffExchangeVolume

tools.description: Get weekly off-exchange (dark pool / OTC) trading volume for an exact stock or ETF listing from the FINRA OTC/ATS Transparency data. Each week shows ATS (alternative trading system / dark pool) volume and trade count, non-ATS OTC volume and trade count, and the total off-exchange volume (ATS + non-ATS OTC). The FINRA file does not include consolidated tape volume, so the off-exchange share of total market volume is not reported here; compute that share elsewhere against a consolidated-volume source. Weeks before 2025-08-11 may include volume from a case-variant sibling security because they predate the ordinal FINRA symbol-map fix and can no longer be re-imported from FINRA's rolling source window. A week appears once FINRA has published all of its tiers, about four weeks after the week ends, so the latest week lags today.

tools.name: GetOptionChain

tools.description: Get the option chain (calls and puts) for a stock for ONE expiration: strike, greeks (delta/gamma/theta/vega), implied volatility, open interest, the latest daily price and the previous traded session's volume. Defaults to the nearest upcoming expiration; pass expiration=YYYY-MM-DD for another (GetOptionExpirations lists them). A chain larger than maxResults returns the contracts nearest the money; narrow with minStrike/maxStrike and type to reach the wings. Each row dates its daily figures by session and its open interest by its own date, or marks either unknown; implied volatility and greeks are model values computed at fetch time. Daily figures are not live quotes. Bid/ask use real-time OPRA on Pro and a 15-minute delayed indicative feed on Plus; Free covers end-of-day data only. For a TSX/TSXV listing or an NSE share or index pass MIC:TICKER, e.g. XTSE:RY, XNSE:NIFTY. Plus and Pro get the exchange's bid/ask, IV and OI in its currency; greeks are computed on XTSE/XTSX only.

Every reported figure is the latest filed value for exactly that fiscal year; ROIC is computed at the year's first filing date from the facts filed by then. The capex split is an estimate shown beside the headline figure, never inside it. A figure that is not on file or not provable is a dash, never an estimate. Money is in the company's reporting currency, every figure of a year in that one currency; a REIT is valued on FFO through GetValuationMultiples instead.

tools.name: GetOwnershipSignals
tools.title: 13F Ownership Signals
tools.description: Who holds a stock and how, measured across every 13F book of the newest closed quarter, beside the quarter before: conviction (filers holding it among their ten largest positions, its weight in their books), crowding (shares held by high-turnover filers and private-fund advisers as % of shares outstanding, with its percentile among stocks at least 10 filers hold), institutional ownership of the estimated free float, holder concentration (Herfindahl, largest ten holders), how long holders have held it, the holders' estimated average cost per share and the share of 13F value held at a loss, active holders' like-for-like change, top-scored managers' net buying, Schedule 13D and 13G filers on record, holder-overlap peers (operating companies whose active holders overlap most, one row per company, funds excluded), and the filers with the highest weight in it. Cost is an estimate from quarter average prices, never a filed figure.

tools.name: GetOwnershipSummary
tools.title: Stock Ownership Summary
tools.description: Get who owns a stock, as shares and % of shares outstanding: 13F institutions, insiders (Forms 3, 4, 5, single-class issuers only), 13D/13G blocks no 13F report already holds, and the remaining float, flagged rather than clipped when negative. Each holder counts once: insiders who file 13Fs, holders a 13F filer reports, and the filers and persons of any 13D or 13G that names a 13F filer, directly or through filings naming one another, are left out of the other lines, by CIK and SEC reporting links, never by name. tools.name: GetShortInterest
tools.title: Short Interest History
tools.description: Get bi-monthly short interest history for an exact stock or ETF listing from FINRA. Shows the reported short position, change from the previous settlement, average daily volume, and days to cover per settlement date. Share counts are restated onto today's split basis so the series stays continuous across stock splits; days to cover is as reported (FINRA caps it at 999.99). High days-to-cover (>5) suggests a potential short squeeze — for short interest as a % of shares outstanding and an actual squeeze-candidate ranking use GetShortSqueezeScores; for the market-wide latest settlement use GetShortInterestSnapshot. For primary operating-company stocks only, the answer may also carry a model estimate of the settlement FINRA has not published yet; it appears BELOW the table and must never be presented as a FINRA figure.

This is the raw FINRA snapshot — for genuine short-squeeze candidate ranking use GetShortSqueezeScores; for one stock or ETF's history use GetShortInterest; for daily short-sale flow use GetShortVolume/GetLargestShortVolume.

tools.name: GetStockPrices
tools.title: Price History
tools.description: Get daily, weekly or monthly OHLCV (Open, High, Low, Close, Volume) price history for a stock. Useful for technical analysis, charting, and price trend analysis. Weekly (ISO week) and monthly bars roll up the daily rows: first open, highest high, lowest low, last close, summed volume, dated by their last session; a week or month the date range cuts is marked partial. A US listing is quoted in USD; a listing on another exchange (MIC:TICKER) is quoted in its own trading currency, which the output names. Captured corporate-action changes trigger a full-history refresh of the exact listed series, but the stored rows do not certify which split basis the provider returned. Do not treat reconciliation status alone as proof that a window is a consistent total-return series. Zero-volume carry-forward candles are excluded because they do not establish a traded market price.
